**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Lead the architectural vision for the Mobile Engineering group, driving the strategy for enterprise mobile platforms, AI\-native engineering, cloud\-native backend services, reusable SDKs, identity security and developer platforms. This role serves as the highest technical authority for mobile engineering, partnering with executive leadership to define long\-term technology strategy across products.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define the multi\-year architecture roadmap for the Mobile engineering group and govern architecture across all mobile initiatives.
* Architect reusable mobile platform capabilities including Authentication SDKs, Identity SDKs, Security SDKs, Shared UI Components, Design System, Analytics, Telemetry, Feature Flags, Offline Sync and Release Frameworks.
* Drive the evolution of enterprise mobile applications into modular, scalable platforms backed by cloud\-native microservices.
* Lead AI\-native engineering adoption including AI\-assisted design, coding, testing, code reviews, documentation and Agentic SDLC practices.
* Partner with Platform Engineering to establish Internal Developer Platforms (IDP), golden paths, reusable CI/CD pipelines and developer experience standards.
* Provide technical leadership across Android, iOS, backend, cloud and security engineering teams.
* Establish architecture governance, technical standards and design review processes.
* Champion engineering excellence through observability, SRE, DORA metrics, Flow Metrics and operational excellence.
* Mentor Principal Engineers, Staff Engineers and senior technical leaders while influencing engineering strategy across business units.
* Represent the Mobile COE in executive architecture reviews and external technical forums.
* Improve engineering productivity through AI\-native engineering and platform automation.
* Standardize architecture, security and operational excellence across all mobile products.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* 18\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 8 years in architecture leadership.
* Deep expertise in Android and iOS native development and enterprise mobile platform architecture.
* Extensive experience with cloud\-native distributed systems, microservices and API ecosystems.
* Proven success leading cross\-functional architecture initiatives across global organizations.
* Excellent communication, executive stakeholder management and technical mentorship skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Identity Security, IAM or Cybersecurity domain expertise.
* Experience building enterprise mobile platforms or Mobile COEs.
* Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms and Developer Experience initiatives.
* Enterprise SaaS and large\-scale cloud\-native architectures.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

YOU MUST HAVE

**Description**
 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
   

  

 We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
   

  

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
   

  

 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
   

  

 We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
   

  

 If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 RBS Tech team puts a high value on work\-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal \& Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE\-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**

**Job Description:** **Our Mission:**


We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.


**About Us:**


Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.


Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.


**Position Summary:**


Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy \& Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional \& Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration \& Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications**:


* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.

****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced and motivated Senior Solutions Architect with deep expertise in SaaS\-based Software\-Defined Vehicles (SDV), connected\-vehicle platforms, and cloud\-native automotive systems. Serving as a trusted technical advisor, you will partner with global OEMs and ecosystem partners to architect scalable, secure, and resilient SDV solutions using the Sibros Deep Connected Platform. In this role, you will bridge technical capabilities with business strategy across vehicle\-to\-cloud connectivity, edge\-to\-cloud data pipelines, digital twins, predictive maintenance, and over\-the\-air (OTA) update programs.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Drive Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for Automotive OEM accounts across India, EU, and Japan, engaging directly with engineering leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Architect Scalable Platforms: Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions for industry\-specific workloads, including connected vehicle systems and SDV data platforms.
* Execute Pre\-Sales \& PoCs: Lead proof\-of\-concept (PoC) engagements, conduct architectural reviews, and actively support customer RFP processes to de\-risk production deployments and drive key opportunities through to closure.
* Lead Custom Solutions: Lead and manage a team of developers to design and deliver custom, customer\-focused solutions, leveraging AI\-assisted tools to improve development speed, quality, and innovation.
* Bridge Enterprise Systems: Direct integrations with enterprise software ecosystems, including MES, PLM, After Sales Systems, SAP, and custom cloud integration workflows.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work closely with customer engineering teams as well as internal Sibros Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams to translate business objectives into deployable technical solutions.


 What You Should Know
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Domain \& Systems Expertise: 15\+ years of experience across specific technology domain areas, including software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, networking, security, and data analytics.
* Architecture \& Design: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud applications and infrastructure architectures.
* Automotive Data Infrastructure: Working knowledge of real\-time and batch data processing at scale, using technologies like MQTT, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, time\-series databases, and data analytics tools applied to connected vehicles.
* Cloud \& Edge Technologies: Working knowledge of major hyperscalers (e.g., AWS, GCP), IoT/edge computing, data lakes, AI/ML, HPC, and DevOps/CI\-CD pipelines.
* Stakeholder Communication: Proven capability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and non\-technical executive stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cross\-Domain Integration: Hands\-on experience integrating cloud\-native SDV architectures with legacy OEM software and enterprise enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP).
* Team \& Innovation Management: Background in leading developer teams with a modern focus on AI\-assisted development tooling to accelerate release cycles.
* Global OEM Exposure: Familiarity navigating complex multi\-region technical requirements and delivery models across India, EU, and Japan markets.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


****Equal Opportunity Employer****

description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

description:
**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Algorithm Architect \- ADAS
   

  

 The Algorithm Architect – ADAS is responsible for defining, designing, and validating algorithms that enable advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving functions. The role focuses on perception, sensor fusion, path planning and control algorithms, ensuring their integration within embedded and high\-performance computing environments. You will serve as the technical authority for algorithmic design, ensuring alignment with system\-level requirements, functional safety, and real\-time constraints.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end algorithmic architecture for ADAS functions such as Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) etc.
* Decompose system\-level ADAS functions into modular algorithm components: perception, fusion, prediction, planning and control.
* Design sensor fusion frameworks (camera, radar, ultrasonic, IMU, GNSS) for accurate environment modeling and object tracking.
* Architect algorithms for multi\-sensor object detection, classification, and tracking, leveraging both traditional signal processing and AI/ML methods.
* Define the software and hardware architecture interfaces to support real\-time execution of algorithms on ECUs, GPUs, and embedded processors.
* Optimize algorithms for embedded performance, latency, and memory efficiency while maintaining high accuracy.
* Collaborate with system architects, software engineers, and data scientists to ensure seamless integration and deployment.
* Conduct algorithm performance evaluations using simulation, SIL/HIL, and on\-vehicle validation.
* Contribute to functional safety (ISO 26262\) and SOTIF (ISO 21448\) compliance from an algorithmic perspective.
* Maintain awareness of latest research and technologies in ADAS, perception, and AI for automotive applications.
* Mentor and guide algorithm engineers in technical design, modeling, and validation best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Robotics or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in ADAS / Autonomous Driving algorithm development or similar domains.
* Deep understanding of sensor processing, computer vision, sensor fusion, path planning, and vehicle control algorithms.
* Strong experience with C/C\+\+, Python, and MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm design and validation.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and embedded AI deployment (CNN \& latest technologies).
* Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive environments.
* Solid understanding of vehicle dynamics, control theory, and state estimation techniques (Kalman Filters, Particle Filters, etc.).
* Experience with HIL/SIL validation, simulation tools (e.g. CarMaker) and data replay systems.
* Working knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262\) and SOTIF concepts.
* Strong grasp of vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) and ECU architecture.
* Familiarity with AI\-based perception pipelines (CNNs, RNNs, transformer\-based architectures) for object detection and tracking.
* Knowledge of sensor calibration, time synchronization, and data fusion frameworks (ROS/ROS2, ADTF, RTMaps).
* Experience with GPU/SoC\-based acceleration (NVIDIA, Qualcomm, TI etc.).
* Exposure to cybersecurity and over\-the\-air (OTA) update strategies.
* Contributions to research papers or patents in the ADAS/autonomous driving field.
* Strong analytical and abstract thinking capabilities.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Leadership and mentoring ability for algorithm development teams.
* Passion for innovation in intelligent mobility and autonomous systems.


**L\&T Company Overview / About Us**
 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.
   

  

 Given L\&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well\-established capabilities in L\&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics \& Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design \& Manufacturing (ESDM). description:
**Role Summary**
 Are you ready to elevate your career and shape the future of our enterprise data platform? We are looking for passionate technology professionals who thrive on solving complex database challenges, driving cloud transformations, and building resilient systems. If you are eager to make a direct technical impact in a high\-growth engineering environment, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 As a Cloud and Enterprise Infrastructure Manager (D7\) in our Core Database Engineering team, you will provide hands\-on technical expertise in the database domain across hybrid environments (On\-Premises, AWS RDS, GCP). Working alongside the Lead DB Architect, you will execute database migrations, optimize enterprise SQL environments, and contribute to the development of reliable, high\-performing database infrastructure following industry best practices. You will participate in technical design reviews, support automated workflows, and build proactive alerting and deployment pipelines for developer environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. High Availability, Disaster Recovery \& Core Operations**
* Manage, monitor, and optimize enterprise SQL Server environments (2016 through 2022 versions), including Always On Availability Groups (AG) and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Oversee core operational health, including native backup and restore models, index management, automated health checks, security hardening, and regular OS/DB patching.
* Maintain high standards for database performance, high availability, and disaster recovery across both Production and Non\-Production setups.


**2\. Cloud Migration \& Infrastructure Automation**
* Execute database migration waves from legacy on\-premises setups to major cloud platforms (AWS EC2/RDS and/or GCP Cloud SQL), minimizing downtime and data risk.
* Develop scripts and workflows using PowerShell, T\-SQL, and cloud CLI tools to automate routine administrative tasks, maintenance, and monitoring.
* Support deployment automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) efforts using tools like AWS CloudFormation or CLI.


**3\. Performance Tuning \& Diagnostic Monitoring**
* Conduct query performance tuning, execution plan analysis, index optimization, and wait\-stat analysis to resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Implement proactive alerting mechanisms and monitor wait stats to sustain peak database efficiency and system responsiveness.
* Collaborate with application teams on schema refactoring, data validation, and query design reviews.


**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Operational Governance**
* Work as part of a global database engineering setup to deliver robust, scalable data platform solutions.
* Foster an operational culture focused on clear documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), detailed runbooks, and continuous process improvement.
* Share constructive feedback during technical design reviews and collaborate with cross\-functional technology teams.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
* Vendor \& Partner Management
* Manage relationships with cloud providers (AWS, GCP), third\-party database software vendors, and managed service providers (MSPs).
* Oversee vendor SLAs, license compliance, contract renewals, and support escalations to ensure high\-priority incidents are resolved rapidly.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal procurement/finance teams on FinOps initiatives to optimize cloud database spend and reduce infrastructure overhead.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 12–14
* years of dedicated enterprise experience as a SQL Server DBA across production and non\-production setups.
* Technical Mastery: Deep knowledge of SQL Server Architecture (2016–2022\), T\-SQL, PowerShell automation, Always On AG, WSFC, AWS (EC2/RDS) and/or GCP Cloud SQL, and basic IaC frameworks.
* Certifications (Preferred):
+ AWS / Cloud Certified Associate or Professional
+ AWS / Cloud Certified Database Specialty

* Core Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem\-solving, adaptability to evolving cloud technologies, proactive communication, team collaboration, and a continuous learning mindset.

title: Solution Architect II - Cloud Infrastructure Services
description:
**Role Description**
 Principal Platform Architect Who We Look For
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Principal Platform Architect** 
 to define, build, and evolve the cloud platform and internal developer platform that underpin UST FinX's engineering organization.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role — not a people\-management position.
   

  

 Your influence will come from designing strong platform foundations, making sound architectural decisions, building production\-grade infrastructure and platform capabilities, mentoring engineers, and raising engineering standards across multiple teams.
   

  

 You will own the technical direction of our platform engineering capabilities across
 **AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, observability, security, reliability, and developer experience** 
 .
   

  

 The goal is not to build infrastructure independently for every project. You will create reusable platform capabilities that can support multiple products, clients, environments, and engineering teams consistently.
   

  

 You understand that a platform is itself an engineering product used by other engineers. It must be reliable, secure, observable, automated, documented, maintainable, and easy to consume.
   

  

 You remain close to implementation: reviewing architecture, building infrastructure and platform components, improving deployment automation, writing code, investigating production issues, and helping teams solve difficult operational problems.
   

  

 You understand that good platform engineering is not simply about provisioning infrastructure. It requires balancing developer autonomy with standardisation, security with usability, abstraction with transparency, and delivery speed with operational control.
   

  

 In an AI\-assisted engineering environment, you apply strong technical judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output. Infrastructure and platform code must meet the same standards for correctness, resilience, security, maintainability, and operational safety as manually produced engineering work.
   

  

 We value a collaborative, merit\-driven engineering culture. Senior architects are expected to constructively challenge weak designs, simplify unnecessary complexity, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help the organisation converge on strong reusable engineering patterns.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Define and evolve the technical architecture of the UST FinX cloud platform and internal developer platform.
* Design and build reusable platform capabilities covering cloud foundations, runtime environments, networking, deployment, observability, security, configuration, and developer self\-service.
* Work hands\-on with AWS and Kubernetes\-based production environments.
* Establish infrastructure\-as\-code patterns that allow environments and platform capabilities to be created, changed, reviewed, tested, and reproduced safely.
* Define automated delivery and GitOps practices covering deployment, environment promotion, rollback, release controls, configuration management, and policy enforcement.
* Design platform capabilities that can be reused consistently across products, clients, environments, and engineering teams.
* Define architectural patterns for cloud networking, identity and access management, workload isolation, security boundaries, deployment models, environment strategy, scalability, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Build production\-quality platform components including reusable infrastructure modules, automation, services, libraries, templates, and reference implementations.
* Design internal developer\-platform capabilities that provide teams with clear, supported paths for building, deploying, operating, and observing applications.
* Establish self\-service workflows that reduce unnecessary dependencies on central platform teams without weakening governance or operational controls.
* Define platform standards for application deployment, configuration, secrets, observability, health management, scaling, resilience, and production readiness.
* Guide teams in designing highly available systems that tolerate infrastructure failure and support predictable recovery.
* Establish observability standards covering metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, s, service health, and reliability objectives.
* Establish platform security patterns covering identity, access control, secrets, encryption, workload isolation, network security, software supply chain, and automated security controls.
* Help engineering teams understand and manage the operational and cost consequences of architectural decisions.
* Partner with backend, frontend, data, DevOps, QA, security, product, and client\-facing teams so that the platform enables delivery rather than becoming an obstacle to it.
* Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and technical direction.
* Ensure platform capabilities are deployable, observable, secure, scalable, recoverable, maintainable, and cost\-aware from the start.


 Reporting Line and Role Context
   

  

 This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX.
   

  

 You will operate as one of the CTO's senior technical leaders, creating engineering leverage across the organization while remaining deeply hands\-on.
   

  

 You will influence multiple engineering teams, establish reusable standards, mentor technical leaders, challenge weak designs, and turn technical direction into production\-quality execution.
   

  

 This is not a passive advisory role and not a traditional people\-management position.
   

  

 Your authority will come from technical credibility, judgment, execution, and your ability to make other engineers and teams more effective.
   

  

 You will work closely with the CTO to define technical standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, evolve the platform architecture, and ensure that architectural direction is reflected in real infrastructure, real code, and operational behaviour.
   

  

 The objective is to act as a technical force multiplier across the engineering organization.
   

  

**Skills And Experience We Are Looking For**
* Minimum 8 years of experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or architecture, ideally 10–15 years with meaningful ownership of production platforms.
* Strong experience designing and operating production cloud platforms on AWS.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture including account and environment strategy, networking, identity and access management, workload isolation, security boundaries, availability, resilience, operational controls, and cost\-aware design.
* Deep production experience with Kubernetes, including cluster architecture, workload scheduling, ingress and traffic management, autoscaling, service discovery, configuration, secrets, application lifecycle, deployment strategies, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with infrastructure as code, including designing reusable infrastructure abstractions, modules, testing approaches, dependency management, and safe infrastructure evolution.
* Strong understanding of GitOps and modern CI/CD, including automated delivery, environment promotion, rollback, release controls, policy enforcement, and deployment safety.
* Experience designing and operating platforms across multiple environments, clients, products, or teams rather than infrastructure for a single application.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including private and public connectivity, routing, load balancing, DNS, service\-to\-service communication, network isolation, and secure connectivity patterns.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, least\-privilege access, service identities, secrets management, encryption, and security boundaries.
* Strong understanding of observability, including metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, ing, service\-level objectives, and production diagnostics.
* Strong production\-engineering experience covering reliability, scalability, recoverability, performance, security, operability, maintainability, and cost efficiency.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, shared platform services, or reusable engineering capabilities consumed by multiple development teams.
* Strong understanding of platform\-product principles, including developer experience, self\-service, sensible defaults, supported paths, documentation, discoverability, and reducing cognitive load for delivery teams.
* Experience building reusable platform abstractions without hiding operational behaviour to the point that teams cannot understand or troubleshoot their systems.
* Experience with production incident response, root\-cause analysis, capacity problems, infrastructure failures, deployment failures, and complex operational troubleshooting.
* Strong software\-engineering capability and the ability to contribute code, automation, infrastructure modules, libraries, tools, or services rather than operating exclusively at architecture level.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain architecture decisions, trade\-offs, risks, and operational consequences clearly to globally distributed engineering teams.
* Strong mentoring capability and the ability to establish technical direction without relying on formal authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and building an internal developer platform or platform product consumed by multiple engineering teams.
* Experience creating reusable engineering capabilities rather than project\-specific infrastructure.
* Experience designing cloud environments that support multiple clients, tenants, products, or organisational boundaries while maintaining appropriate isolation.
* Experience designing self\-service capabilities for environment provisioning, application deployment, configuration, operational tooling, or other recurring engineering activities.
* Experience with advanced Kubernetes networking, traffic\-management, ingress, service\-to\-service communication, and workload\-security patterns.
* Experience designing highly available and resilient distributed platforms across multiple availability zones or equivalent failure domains.
* Experience with API\-first, event\-driven, microservice, and integration\-heavy enterprise architectures.
* Strong software development experience where platform capabilities interact with backend services, APIs, automation, or shared engineering libraries.
* Experience building developer tooling, automation, command\-line utilities, portals, APIs, or other interfaces that improve developer experience.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code, automated governance, security automation, secrets management, software supply\-chain security, vulnerability management, and compliance\-oriented controls.
* Experience implementing platform observability across infrastructure and applications, including common standards for telemetry, correlation, dashboards, ing, and operational diagnostics.
* Experience designing backup, recovery, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity strategies for critical cloud platforms.
* Experience implementing safe deployment approaches including progressive delivery, automated rollback, health validation, and controlled environment promotion.
* Experience designing platforms for financial services, banking, payments, or other regulated environments where security, auditability, resilience, segregation, and operational control are critical.
* Experience evaluating competing platform technologies based on reliability, operational complexity, developer experience, portability, cost, ecosystem maturity, and long\-term maintainability rather than technology preference.
* Experience living with the long\-term consequences of platform architecture decisions — supporting, patching, debugging, scaling, securing, migrating, and evolving a platform after widespread organisational adoption.


**About UST FinX**
 UST FinX is a financial technology initiative within UST focused on modernizing core banking infrastructure for mid\-sized and large financial institutions.
   

  

 Backed by UST's global engineering scale and financial\-services experience, we combine product engineering, systems integration, and managed services into a unified transformation offering.
   

  

 Our approach is based on progressive modernization: allowing modern and legacy systems to coexist while institutions progressively move toward API\-driven, event\-driven, cloud\-ready banking platforms.
   

  

 We emphasize interoperability, scalability, resilience, security, strong engineering practices, and operational control.
   

  

 UST FinX operates as a long\-term transformation partner, helping financial institutions reduce operational risk, simplify complex technology landscapes, strengthen engineering maturity, and accelerate the delivery of new banking capabilities.
   

  

 We are building the platform engineering foundation that enables the next generation of digital banking.

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 **hands\-on IC role, not an advisory one** 
 . You write design documents, build foundational components, review critical PRs, and set the engineering quality bar by example. You report to the Director of Engineering and are the senior technical IC in the stream, collaborating with the Engineering Manager on delivery and with Tech Leads across squads on implementation quality. The right person reasons from first principles in distributed systems and system design. Cloud\-native production experience required; Azure preferred.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Architecture Ownership**
* Own the Agent Stream architecture end\-to\-end — the orchestration engine, inter\-agent contracts (handoffs, shared context, escalation chains), data layer design, and on\-prem to cloud migration sequencing: what moves first, what requires refactoring, how to maintain continuity throughout.
* Define structured event emission standards for every agent — what must be emitted for platform\-level observability, audit, and metering. Own instrumentation standards that enable traceability and evaluation across the stream.
* Make and document foundational architecture decisions with clear rationale, trade\-off analysis, and long\-term implications. Proactively identify design debt, scalability bottlenecks, and failure cascade risks before they affect delivery.


**Hands\-On Technical Delivery**
* Commit to code — build foundational components, review critical PRs, lead high and low\-level design sessions, whiteboard architecture decisions, and challenge proposals with depth.
* Collaborate with the Platform Architect on decisions that span agent and platform layers: event contracts, authentication boundaries, and service integration patterns.
* Define and enforce engineering standards across the Agent Stream — API contract design, service observability, test coverage, and event emission. Provide technical direction to Agent Stream Tech Leads as the senior technical IC.


**Who You Are**
**Distributed Systems \& System Design — Primary Gate**
* 12\+ years in software engineering with primary depth in large\-scale distributed systems — failure modes, scalability trade\-offs, and design reasoning from first principles. Engineering reasoning is the gate, not tool familiarity. The ability to explain why a design was chosen, what failure modes it introduces, and what changes under different constraints is what is evaluated.
* Owns all Agent Stream architecture end\-to\-end: component boundaries, data contracts, and service\-level design at both high and low level.


**Cloud Native \& Infrastructure**
* Production experience on at least one public cloud — Azure preferred. Includes Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous release practices. Experience sequencing on\-prem to cloud migrations: what moves first, what requires refactoring, and how to maintain continuity.


**Security \& Identity**
* OAuth 2\.0 and IAM — production experience with authentication flows, token management, and identity propagation across services. Defence\-in\-depth awareness sufficient to design agents that do not introduce security gaps. Identifies risks and escalates to the Platform Architect.


**API, Event \& Data Design**
* API design and OpenAPI contracts — service\-level agent boundaries and inter\-service communication patterns. Event emission design for structured downstream platform consumption covering observability, audit, and metering.
* Multi\-tenant patterns: tenant isolation, scoped data access, and per\-tenant configuration at agent and service level. PostgreSQL at production scale: schema design, query optimisation, and data modelling for agent state and audit logs.


**Code Quality \& Standards**
* Defines what well\-structured, testable, and observable code looks like at the architectural level. Reviews critical code across the stream, identifies systemic quality issues, and sets the engineering bar through example.


**Awareness**
* Workflow orchestration — Temporal or equivalent event\-driven patterns, sufficient to design agents integrating correctly with the platform workflow layer. Observability: trace standards, structured logging, Langfuse. Security principles beyond OAuth sufficient to identify risks and escalate to the Platform Architect.


**Nice to Have**
* LangChain and LangGraph — agent orchestration frameworks for building and composing multi\-step agent graphs, tool use, and state management. Familiarity with AI\-native SDLC and Human\-led Agentic SDLC practices is a plus.
* Production experience in Python — enables deeper code review and hands\-on contribution to the agent codebase. Not a gate for this role; architecture depth matters more than the language.
* Azure certification demonstrating cloud platform depth. Financial close or R2R domain experience to accelerate ramp\-up on the business context the platform serves.


**What You’ll Learn \& Gain**
* End\-to\-end ownership of the technical architecture layer on a live enterprise financial platform used by global customers. Your architectural decisions are implemented at scale, with direct visibility into how they shape product behaviour and engineering outcomes.
* Deep hands\-on experience in distributed systems design, cloud\-native engineering, and event\-driven architecture in a production context where scalability, auditability, and reliability all matter simultaneously and cannot be traded off lightly.
* Exposure to building AI agent infrastructure in a high\-compliance, SOX\-governed environment — learning to balance system performance with explainability, traceability, and enterprise audit requirements in a production AI product.
* Close collaboration with engineering managers, tech leads, and a platform architect in a fast\-moving, squad\-based delivery model. Your architectural choices are implemented and validated rapidly, with tight feedback loops between design decisions and production outcomes.


 If you are an engineer who reasons from first principles, has shipped production distributed systems, and is ready to own the architectural foundation of an enterprise AI platform — we encourage you to apply.
   

  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
