title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000\+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event\-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins\-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch\-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large\-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
* Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare\-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality\-of\-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
* Helping invent next\-generation semiconductor design methodology.
* Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.


**What We Want To See**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
* Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
* Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.
* Comfort owning and debugging Linux\-based production services.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
* Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.
* Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design.


 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager - Product (Python)
description:
Sia Partners is a next\-generation global management consulting firm, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Paris, France. The firm is recognised for its innovative approach, combining strategy and management consulting with data science and creativity. Sia Partners serves a diverse range of sectors, including energy, banking, healthcare, and technology, providing services to over 1,000 clients worldwide, including many Fortune 500 companies. With a strong emphasis on delivering tangible results and superior value, Sia Partners is committed to helping clients navigate the digital revolution and achieve transformation. The firm operates with a global presence, employing over 3,500 consultants across 48 locations in 20 countries
   

  

  

  

 Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Sia Partners is looking for an Engineering Manager \- Product to support the design and delivery of next\-generation AI and Generative AI platforms within Sia’s AI Factory. This role is pivotal in bridging high\-level product vision with robust, cloud\-native engineering execution.
   

  





 You will work closely with product, data science, and platform teams to translate business and client requirements into robust technical solutions. The role requires strong Python expertise, experience with distributed systems and microservices, and a pragmatic approach to delivering reliable, scalable systems in enterprise environments. In addition to technical delivery, you will contribute to architectural decisions, raise engineering standards, and support client\-facing engagements through technical leadership and clear communication.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  




* Team Leadership: Hire, coach, and retain top\-tier software and cloud engineers. Establish trust through architectural design sessions and code reviews, fostering a culture of ownership, high performance, and continuous innovation.


* Cloud \& Product Strategy: Define and drive quarterly technical roadmaps that align software delivery with business priorities. Lead the evolution of our cloud ecosystem, focusing on scalability, cost\-optimization, and seamless AI integration within our SaaS products.


* Architecture \& Cloud Design Reviews: Ensure the highest standards of scalability, security, and performance across all cloud\-based services. Embed architectural guardrails and "Cloud\-First" best practices, ensuring documentation and coding guidelines are followed.


* Hands\-On Technical Influence: Contribute targeted PRs (scaffolding, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, developer experience improvements) to maintain a pulse on the codebase without occupying the critical delivery path.


* Operational Excellence: Uphold the philosophy of "you build it, you run it." Optimize CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment strategies to increase delivery velocity while maintaining system stability.


* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Research, and Ops to transform ambiguous product requirements into actionable technical milestones, ensuring frequent delivery of customer\-visible value.


* Talent Development: Engage in recruiting and empowering premier engineering talent. Attract and develop engineers who excel in collaborative environments and are passionate about building world\-class software products.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or Physics.


* Over 8 years in software development, with at least 2 years in a leadership role managing software or cloud engineering teams. Proven track record in the technology product sector with a deep understanding of SaaS lifecycles.


* Core Skills: Expertise in algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems. Deep understanding of cloud\-native design patterns and microservices architecture.


* Languages \& Frameworks: Strong proficiency in Python (core) or Working familiarity with Node.js and React.js is highly valued.


* AI\-Native Engineering Leadership: Experience managing teams that utilize Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code as a core part of their daily workflow.


* Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience building and launching modern SaaS products on public cloud platforms, specifically AWS. Proficient in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).


* Leadership \& Communication: A decisive leader who prioritizes action and outcomes. Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across global functions. Strong command of English (written and verbal) for effective communication at all organizational levels.


* Global Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead in a global environment, attracting and retaining top engineering talent while working across different time zones and cultures.



**EM \- Product Traits (What Success Looks Like)**



* AI Product Ownership: Owns delivery of AI/GenAI products from problem framing to production impact.


* Outcome\-Driven Delivery: Focuses on business value, not just model or feature completion.


* Product–Engineering Alignment: Partners tightly with Product / Business to convert AI use cases into executable plans.


* Technical Judgment: Understands AI system trade\-offs (latency, cost, accuracy, reliability) and challenges decisions when needed.


* Delivery Predictability: Breaks complex AI initiatives into incremental, shippable milestones.


* Quality \& Reliability: Ensures production\-grade AI systems (monitoring, failure handling, iteration readiness).


* Client \& Stakeholder Communication: Clearly explains AI limitations, risks, and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders.


* Team Leadership: Builds and grows high\-ownership product engineers and applied AI teams.


* Managing Ambiguity: Operates effectively with evolving requirements and experimental problem spaces.


* Calm Ownership: Leads with accountability under delivery pressure and changing priorities.


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**



* Opportunity to lead cutting\-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.



**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**




 Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Congratulations,** 
 you have taken the first step towards bagging a career\-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.
 



  





**About Seclore:** 




 Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit
 
 www.seclore.com
 
 .
 



  





**You would love our tribe:** 




 If you are a risk\-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!
 



  





 We are seeking a customer\-focused Technical Consultant to provide end\-to\-end technical consulting, solution design, deployment, upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting, performance analysis, training, and documentation for Seclore solutions. The role requires hands\-on expertise across Windows/Linux infrastructure, web and application servers, databases, networking, security, Docker, and cloud technologies — plus the ability to translate complex customer requirements into practical solutions and use AI tools responsibly to boost technical productivity.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Consulting \& Solution Design** 



* Run technical discovery workshops and analyze customer environments to design deployment and integration architectures.
* Prepare HLD/LLD, sizing, and configuration documentation, and act as technical advisor through the implementation lifecycle.



  





**Deployment, Upgrades \& Migrations** 



* Lead end\-to\-end installation, configuration, integration, and production\-readiness of Seclore solutions.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, redeployments, and platform transformations with minimal customer disruption.



  





**Troubleshooting \& Performance** 



* Diagnose complex issues via log, system, and network analysis; drive structured root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Perform health checks, performance benchmarking, infrastructure sizing, and capacity planning with actionable recommendations.



  





**Enterprise Security \& Cloud** 



* Work with AD/LDAP, SSL/TLS, DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and enterprise authentication systems to secure deployments.
* Support on\-prem, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and Docker/containerized deployments, including container networking and lifecycle management.



  





**Automation, AI \& Documentation** 



* Automate deployment, monitoring, and operational tasks using PowerShell/Shell (Python a plus); build reusable tooling.
* Use approved GenAI/LLM tools responsibly for research, troubleshooting, and documentation, validating outputs before use.
* Maintain high\-quality technical documentation — HLD/LLD, deployment guides, migration plans, and health\-check reports.



  





**Customer \& Project Management** 



* Act as trusted technical advisor and primary point of contact, managing expectations across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Sales, Presales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Cloud/DevOps teams to deliver projects on time and to quality.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong background in enterprise software deployment, implementation, and troubleshooting, with solid infrastructure and architecture knowledge.
* Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu), Apache/Tomcat, SSL/TLS, and core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewall, proxy, load balancer).
* Relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle) and Docker/containerized application deployments.
* Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud networking/security fundamentals.
* PowerShell/Shell scripting for automation; Python is a plus.
* Practical awareness of GenAI/LLM tools and responsible AI usage, including data privacy and output validation.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills; able to work independently and cross\-functionally.
* Strong ownership, prioritization, and a continuous\-learning mindset across multiple concurrent projects.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Certifications such as RHCSA/RHCE, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, or Microsoft.
* Experience with enterprise cybersecurity/information\-security products and large, complex deployments.
* Experience with cloud/platform migration, containerization, or performance benchmarking.
* Knowledge of DevOps/CI/CD, security hardening, and REST API integrations.



  





**Working Hours \& Flexibility** 



* Ability and willingness to work flexible hours to support customers across different global time zones.
* Working hours may be adjusted based on project schedules and customer requirements, with planned activities communicated in advance wherever possible.
* Willingness to participate in an on\-call or extended\-hours support arrangement when required for critical customer activities.



  





**What We Look For** 




 We're looking for a customer\-focused technologist with a “learn, solve, automate, and improve” mindset — comfortable in complex enterprise environments and ready to grow with Seclore's technology landscape across cloud, containers, automation, security, and AI.
 



  





***Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together.***

title: Sr Specialist, ERP Indirect Tax Vertex Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**The Position**
 Under the direction of Organon Cross Functional Expert Lead: SAP Vertex Indirect Tax Architect is responsible for providing SAP functional and technical support to Organon Finance, Supply and Tax users. The role requires a solid understanding of SAP FI/CO and Tax related customizing, as well as configuration knowledge and expertise in Vertex On Demand 9\.0 Accelerator / LCRD tool, Compliance reporting, including integration points to Coupa for indirect procurement, as well as SAP MM and SD modules. Expert level knowledge of accounting principles is important. Hands on implementation experience of Vertex software and related components is extremely important as well as the ability to troubleshoot issues related to Indirect Tax. Deep knowledge of complex flows within the Pharma industry including plants abroad, tri\-trade, quad\-trade, intercompany service billing concepts are key for this role.
   

  

 This position requires deep functional \& application knowledge, the ability to work independently with very little hand holding and with technical support and cross functional (STS / OTC) teams. Experience in SAP S4 HANA environment is necessary. The individual should ensure that design and development of systems meet specifications and requirements of Organon’s overall business needs. The role will be within Business Technology and have oversight over system configuration changes, also ensuring that Compliance requirements as far as documentation and testing standards are strictly adhered to.
   

  

 Support the Cross\-Functional Process Expert Lead by designing, governing, and improving end\-to\-end (E2E) processes across domains. Ensure process harmonization, standardization, and smooth cross\-system handoffs across ERP and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

Provide impact analysis for upcoming changes, releases, and cross\-functional initiatives. Enforce modelling standards, naming conventions, and process policies.
* Ensure proper approvals, documentation quality, and compliance with enterprise controls. Maintain the enterprise process repository and ensure consistent version management. Collaborate with Product Owners, Architecture, Data Governance, and Operations teams.


 Expected Outcomes
   

  

* Reduced process fragmentation and fewer variants across the enterprise.
* Smoother and more reliable handoffs across systems, functions, and domains.
* Better visibility into cross\-system dependencies and reduced release\-related risks.
* Standardized, high\-quality process documentation used consistently across teams.


 Decision Rights
   

  

* Recommend and enforce process modelling standards.
* Approve or reject process exceptions or variants.
* Validate cross\-system impacts for major changes.
* Influence Product Owner backlogs where E2E process alignment is affected.


**Required Education, Experience And Skills**
* 7\-10\+ years relevant functional and technical experience in Indirect taxes, specifically SAP FI/CO, Tax bolt on Vertex 9\.0, Chain flow Accelerator tool, LCRD tool, Vendor reconciliation tool. Configuration knowledge as well as hands on practical experience in troubleshooting issues is a requirement.
* Strong knowledge and background in Accounting.
* Experience in implementing and configuring SAP Document and Reporting Compliance modules such as e\-invoicing/Reporting, withholding tax, and real\-time reporting
* Work with the Business Owners / Users and IT Team members to analyze, test, and implement solutions to meet business requirements driven by the TAX team.
* Work on Tax requirement changes as needed; try to stay current with Indirect and WHT tax rule changes in different countries.
* Excellent facilitation and cross\-functional alignment capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate, communicate and coordinate with business and IT stakeholders.
* Analytical, structured problem\-solving and process thinking. Ability to influence without authority and communicate clearly. Governance\-minded, detail\-oriented, and organized

title: Estimation Engineer- Real estate
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented Estimation Engineer with a strong background in the real estate sector. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate and comprehensive cost estimates for various real estate development projects, including residential, commercial, and mixed\-use properties. This role requires a deep understanding of construction methods, materials, labor costs, and market trends within the real estate industry to ensure competitive and precise project budgeting.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Prepare detailed cost estimates for all phases of real estate development projects, from conceptual design to final construction, including civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and finishes.
* Conduct thorough quantity take\-offs from architectural, structural, and MEP drawings and specifications using industry\-standard software and manual methods.
* Analyze project specifications, tender documents, contract terms, and other documentation to fully understand project scope and requirements.
* Collaborate with architects, engineers, project managers, and clients to gather necessary information and clarify project details.
* Obtain and evaluate competitive bids and quotations from subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors for materials, labor, and equipment.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of cost information, including historical data, material pricing, labor rates, and equipment costs.
* Identify potential risks, opportunities, and value engineering options to optimize project costs without compromising quality or schedule.
* Prepare detailed cost breakdowns, budgets, cash flow projections, and financial reports for internal review and client presentations.
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings, site visits, and client negotiations to present and defend cost estimates.
* Stay updated on the latest construction techniques, material innovations, market prices, and regulatory requirements relevant to the real estate industry.
* Assist in the preparation of tender documents, contract agreements, and procurement strategies.
* Provide support during the project lifecycle, including cost control, variation orders, and final account reconciliation.

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Job Title:** Assistant Design Coordinator \- Architecture experience in Commercial and Retail.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
**Design Process Management:** Establishing and managing protocols for the entire design phase, including setting up document control systems and tracking the progress of consultants.
  
**Stakeholder Liaison:** Serving as the primary point of contact between clients, internal project managers, and external design consultants (architects, MEP engineers, etc.).
  
**Technical Reviews \& Compliance:** Reviewing design submissions and shop drawings to ensure they comply with building codes, project specifications, and the client’s approved requirements.
  
**Schedule \& Milestone Tracking:** Maintaining the "Drawing Release Schedule" and "GFC (Good for Construction) Drawing Logs" to ensure that the site team never runs out of approved plans.
  
**Clash Detection \& Value Engineering:** Working with BIM teams for coordination (e.g., ensuring plumbing doesn't hit structural beams) and identifying cost\-saving opportunities through value engineering.
  
**Budgetary Control:** Monitoring design\-related expenses, tracking allowances against actual costs, and managing change orders to prevent budget overruns.
  
**Administrative Support:** Organizing and chairing design meetings, recording minutes, and ensuring follow\-up actions are completed by the relevant consultants.
  
Typical Software \& Tools
  
In this role, proficiency in both design and management software is essential:
  
**Education:** A degree in Architecture,
  
**Design/BIM:** AutoCAD and Revit for reviewing technical plans.
  
**Project Management:** Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Project for timeline tracking.
  
**Collaboration:** Document management systems like Planview or Jira for tracking issues and approvals.
  
  

Common Project Types
  
Commercial
  
Retail
  
Hotels

title: Engineering Team Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.** 




  





 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 



  





**What does Access offer you?** 




  





 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 



  





 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 



  





 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.



  





**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




  





**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.



  





**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.



  





**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.



  





**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




  





**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.



  





**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.



  





**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.

**OSS \& Tools**

**Job Purpose**
 Seeking a visionary and technical leader for the role of
 **General Manager (GM) – Project Management** 
 . Own end\-to\-end SNOC integration planning, solution assessment and architecture for new products, network elements, applications and technology projects across RAN, Core, IP/CEN, Enterprise, OSS and Cloud domains. Evaluate OEM solutions, understand architecture and data flows, finalize SNOC scope and tool mapping, identify and close technical gaps/deviations, and ensure complete monitoring across Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Fault, Performance and Logs. Drive the solution from requirement intake and project planning through design, testing, Go\-Live, stabilization and SNOC/COG HOTO while coordinating OEMs, SNOC domains, COG, OSS, Automation, Architecture, Security and Operations.
   

  

 Bridge strategic engineering with 24/7 operational excellence to scale telecom infrastructure across different SNOC Applications while ensuring strict adherence to global compliance, data privacy, and telecom quality standards.
   

  

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**
 Multi\-Domain Telecom Solution Architecture, SNOC Tools \& Integration Interface Expertise: Demonstrated experience in telecom solution architecture and SNOC integration across RAN, Core, OSS, TX, IP, Enterprise, Cloud and VoLTE domains. Mandatory hands\-on understanding of TEMIP, NNMi, NPM, SevOne, UHC, Infiworx, UIM and APM, with the ability to map domain solutions, monitoring requirements and end\-to\-end data flows to the appropriate SNOC tools and integration interfaces including SNMP, REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus with minimum of 2 years of experience.
   

  

 Integration Interface \& Protocol Engineering: Strong mandatory technical expertise in REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus integrations, covering API authentication, TLS/SSL, payload and response validation, error handling, timeout and retry mechanisms, Kafka topics, partitions, offsets and consumer lag, Webhook acknowledgement and idempotency, and Prometheus exporters, metrics and PromQL. Proficiency in PCAP, logs, traces, MIB/OID and protocol\-level troubleshooting is required.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Fault, Performance \& RCA Engineering: Mandatory capability to troubleshoot end\-to\-end Fault and Performance flows from Network Element or Domain through EMS, interface, middleware and SNOC platforms to ITSM, including alarm generation, severity, mapping, raise and clear, correlation, duplicate, missing and delayed events and ticket flow. Must be able to troubleshoot Bulkstat, KPI, API, Kafka and Prometheus performance flows, perform source\-to\-SNOC reconciliation and isolate failures across source, interface, processing and SNOC layers with evidence\-based technical RCA.
   

  

 Project Integration Management: Lead SNOC integration from requirement intake, solution assessment and scope finalization through testing, Go\-Live and HOTO
   

  

 SNOC Integration Strategy \& Planning Leadership: Define end\-to\-end integration strategy, scope, milestones, dependencies, prerequisites and execution plan for new projects and products.
   

  

 Solution \& Integration Architecture: Analyze OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational model to determine the right SNOC integration approach.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Monitoring Architecture: Ensure monitoring coverage for Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Processes, Faults, Performance and Logs.
   

  

 OEM Solution Assessment: Understand and technically evaluate OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational workflows before finalizing the integration approach.
   

  

 Solution\-to\-SNOC Mapping: Map OEM solution architecture against SNOC tool capabilities and determine the right integration points, monitoring platforms and operational workflows.
   

  

 Technical Risk Management: Identify integration, architecture, security and operational risks and drive mitigation before deployment.
   

  

 Fault Management Architecture: Design alarm/event flow from network element to SNOC including normalization, severity, correlation, suppression, raise/clear and auto\-ticketing.
   

  

 Performance Management Architecture: Define KPI/counter integration through Bulkstat, APIs, Prometheus, telemetry or other performance interfaces.
   

  

 Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC): Drive standardization, reusable integration patterns, architecture governance, FTR improvement, defect prevention and continuous engineering transformation to accelerate technology onboarding and improve overall SNOC operational excellence.
   

  

 Data Privacy \& Security Enforcement: Enforce secure\-by\-design practices across SNOC integrations, including RBAC, API/SNMP/Kafka security, data protection and controlled access to sensitive network data.
   

  

 HOTO \& Operational Readiness: Ensure complete integration evidence, monitoring coverage, testing results and operational acceptance before SNOC/COG handover
   

  

 Database \& Backup Governance: Ensure database integration, data consistency, backup validation and recovery readiness across SNOC ecosystem platforms.
   

  

 Automated Observability: Drive automation for integration validation, alarm testing, reconciliation, health checks and monitoring validation to improve FTR and reduce rework.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
* Overall Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of progressive, post\-qualification experience in Project and Telecom management.

title: Lead Associate - Quality
description:
### **Description**

  

As a **Senior Automation Test Associate Engineer**, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of Davies' technology solutions through automated and manual testing. Reporting to the **Senior Manager of Development**, you will design, develop, execute, and maintain test automation solutions while working closely with Product Owners, Developers, Architects, DevOps Engineers, and business stakeholders to promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
  

The ideal candidate will have **8\-12 years of QA and Test Automation experience**, with strong expertise in test planning, test case design, automation framework development, automation coding, defect analysis, and CI/CD\-integrated testing within Agile Scrum teams.  

This is a hands\-on role focused on delivering high\-quality software through effective test automation, quality engineering best practices, risk identification, defect investigation, and continuous improvement initiatives. The position is a **permanent hybrid role based in Pune**, offering the opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovation\-driven engineering environment.### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Quality leadership and team development*** Lead, support and develop Test Analysts and other quality practitioners, setting clear expectations and providing coaching, feedback and practical guidance.
* Champion shared ownership of quality within cross\-functional teams and help squads make evidence\-based decisions about coverage, risk and release readiness.
* Define and promote proportionate quality standards, testing practices and ways of working, ensuring they are understood and applied consistently.
* Build effective working relationships with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders.

**Test strategy, planning and assurance*** Develop and maintain risk\-based test strategies and plans aligned to business outcomes, technical change, delivery approach and project constraints.
* Assess change impact, dependencies and quality risks early; define suitable test levels, types, environments, data, tooling, entry and exit criteria, and evidence requirements.
* Ensure test coverage is traceable to requirements, acceptance criteria, risks and critical business processes without creating unnecessary administration.
* Plan regression, integration, system, exploratory, non\-functional and user acceptance testing as appropriate to the change.
* Monitor testing progress, quality indicators, defects and residual risk, communicating concise and actionable information to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute quality evidence and recommendations to collective release\-readiness decisions; escalate material gaps or risks clearly and promptly.

**Hands\-on testing and defect investigation*** Personally design, execute and maintain tests when needed, using manual and/or automated techniques appropriate to the context.
* Undertake exploratory, functional, integration, regression and other relevant testing of new and existing functionality.
* Create clear, maintainable test cases, charters, data and evidence at a level proportionate to the risk and delivery need.
* Identify, isolate, reproduce and document defects; support root\-cause analysis and verify fixes.
* Use relevant tools to inspect applications, interfaces, APIs, data and logs where required to investigate behaviour and build confidence.
* Review test assets and results produced by others, helping ensure coverage is meaningful, efficient and focused on risk.

**Automation and continuous improvement*** Evaluate where automation will provide sustainable value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
* Contribute to the design, implementation or maintenance of automated checks where this matches the individual’s skills and the needs of the team.
* Work with engineers to improve testability and embed appropriate quality checks within the development and delivery lifecycle.
* Identify bottlenecks, duplication and gaps in the QA process and implement pragmatic improvements to quality, speed, coverage and transparency.
* Evaluate and recommend suitable testing tools and techniques, keeping current with relevant developments in software quality.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Experience*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
* 10–15 years of automation and quality assurance testing experience.
* Background in web integration testing preferred.

**Skills*** Strong experience in manual and automation testing, with expertise in Selenium, Playwright, frontend UI automation, backend/API automation, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Proven experience leading QA activities for complex products and Agile delivery teams.
* Strong test strategy, test design, exploratory testing, regression planning, and defect management skills.
* Ability to apply risk\-based testing approaches and make pragmatic quality decisions.
* Experience coaching and mentoring QA engineers and driving quality best practices.
* Strong understanding of Agile, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong business awareness with the ability to evaluate customer and operational impact.
* Ability to learn new domains quickly and collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.

**Essential (Non Negotiable)*** Experience testing APIs, integrations, data flows or databases, using tools such as Postman and SQL or equivalent.
* Experience with test\-management, defect\-management, delivery and collaboration tools.
* Experience with automation frameworks, continuous integration pipelines, performance testing, observability or application monitoring.
* Experience working in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment.
* A relevant testing qualification such as ISTQB Foundation Level, or equivalent applied experience.

  

### **About Davies**


We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist


In this role, you will:


Quality leadership \& strategy

* Own the Quality Engineering strategy for your area, aligned to product outcomes, delivery plans, and risk appetite.
* Define and evolve testing practices, principles, and standards (e.g., test triangle, shift\-left, risk\-based testing, quality gates).
* Establish measurable quality objectives and drive continuous improvement (defect leakage, cycle time, automation ROI, stability).


Automation architecture \& engineering

* Act as Automation Architect: design scalable, maintainable automation frameworks and patterns across UI/API/Data/DB/integration/API contract/component layers (as relevant).
* Set engineering standards for test code: clean code, design patterns, code reviews, branching strategy, and reusable libraries.
* Build and optimize CI/CD\-integrated automation pipelines (smoke/regression suites, parallel execution, environment readiness checks), support continuous testing through CI/CD.
* Reduce flakiness and improve signal quality through robust synchronization, test data management, and observability.


Test approach \& delivery excellence

* Define test strategies for epics/features, including functional, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Lead quality risk assessments and ensure appropriate coverage for critical journeys, controls, and operational resilience.
* Support non\-functional testing approaches (performance, resilience, accessibility, and security testing alignment).


Generative AI \& agentic AI exposure (quality enablement)

* Bring practical exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI concepts to enhance QE outcomes (e.g., accelerating test design, improving coverage analysis, and automating repetitive QE tasks).
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted testing capabilities responsibly, such as:
* AI\-assisted test case generation from requirements/user stories (with human review and traceability).
* AI\-supported automation development (e.g., code suggestions, refactoring, test data generation).
* Intelligent test selection and prioritization using change impact signals and historical results.
* Agentic workflows for triage support (e.g., clustering failures, suggesting likely root causes, proposing reruns) with clear guardrails.


Practice enrichment \& continuous improvement

* Introduce and embed modern testing techniques: contract testing, component testing, service virtualization, synthetic monitoring, and resilience testing (where appropriate).
* Drive root\-cause analysis for quality issues and implement preventative actions (not just fixes).
* Define quality metrics and dashboards; communicate quality health, risks, and release readiness with evidence.

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling agentic AI capabilities that transform how we manage requirements, BOMs, CAD/CAM data, and service lifecycles. * Governance \& Scaling: Define the AI maturity roadmap, ensuring all deployments meet strict enterprise standards for data privacy, IP protection, and cost governance.


**What You Bring**
* Required total 7\+ years of experience along with relevant experience 3 years in Artificial Intelligence.

title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2016230
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next\-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands\-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high\-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Defining and driving server\-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
* Conducting hands\-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
* Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root\-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
* Performing trade\-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
* Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring\-up through production
* Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
* Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross\-functional design discussions
* Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next\-generation server platforms
* Publishing internal performance studies and best\-practice guides for partner and customer enablement


**What We Need To See**
* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
* Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
* Strong hands\-on experience with system\-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
* Solid knowledge of GPU\-accelerated compute, high\-performance networking, or high\-performance storage subsystems
* Proficiency in Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
* Comfortable and proficient using AI\-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data\-centre scale
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL)
* Background in chip\-to\-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe)
* Exposure to power/thermal\-aware performance optimisation techniques
* Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies

title: Network AIOPs Engineer (Remote)
description:

The position will partner closely withnetwork engineering, infrastructure, SRE, and operations teams to improve the effectiveness, reliability, andscalability of the AI Ops platform and its supporting ecosystem.
 



  





**Experience: 5\+ years** 




**Location: India (Remote)** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Engineer, configure, and support integrations between the Network AIOps platform and network, infrastructure, and operational data sources including telemetry, alerts, events, logs, incidents, and topology data.
* Build and maintain software, automation, and platform services that improve Network AIOps platform reliability, data quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and enhance ingestion pipelines, normalization logic, enrichment workflows, and data transformation processes used to support event correlation and operational intelligence.
* Partner with networking teams to onboard data sources from routers, switches, firewalls, controllers, cloud networking environments, and related monitoring systems.
* Improve observability and operational support for the Network AIOps platform through dashboards, alerting, health checks, tracing, and diagnostics.
* Support operational use cases such as incident triage, anomaly detection, root cause workflows, event correlation, and service\-impact analysis.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, data flow, integration, and production issues across application, infrastructure, and network domains.
* Develop automation to reduce manual operational effort and improve response times for network incidents and platform support activities.
* Contribute to architecture and design for scalable, resilient, and secure Network AIOps platform capabilities.
* Support platform upgrades, release validation, environment management, and change implementation activities.
* Write maintainable code, scripts, APIs, and infrastructure\-as\-code to improve repeatability and operational consistency.
* Participate in on\-call support or operational escalation processes as required for platform and production support.
* Document integrations, workflows, support procedures, operational runbooks, and technical designs.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, or systems engineering experience in production environments.
* Experience supporting or integrating operational platforms used in network operations, observability, NOC, SRE, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in one or more languages such as Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript.
* Experience building or supporting data integrations, APIs, event processing pipelines, or automation services.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including routing, switching, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs, and network monitoring concepts.
* Experience with telemetry and observability data such as metrics, events, logs, traces, SNMP, syslog, traps, streaming telemetry, or API\-based operational data.
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern infrastructure environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience troubleshooting production issues across integrated systems and driving incidents to resolution.
* Understanding of CI/CD, testing, release management, and secure engineering practices.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Direct experience with AI Operations platforms, event intelligence, or network observability platforms.
* Experience integrating with systems such as monitoring tools, ITSM platforms, CMDBs, topology services, ticketing systems, and incident/event management tools.
* Familiarity with network management and observability ecosystems, including tools that collect telemetry, alarms, fault data, and performance metrics.
* Experience with data parsing, enrichment, correlation logic, or streaming/event\-driven architectures.
* Exposure to machine learning\-assisted operations, anomaly detection workflows, or operational analytics platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, REST APIs, Python automation frameworks, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Familiarity with Linux systems administration, message queues, JSON/YAML data modeling, and authentication/integration patterns.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise or service\-provider network environments.



  





**Success in this Role:** 



* Improve the quality, reliability, and usefulness of operational data flowing into the Network AIOps platform.
* Deliver durable engineering solutions that improve network visibility and reduce operational noise.
* Strengthen incident detection, diagnosis, and support workflows across the networking organization.
* Reduce manual effort through automation, integration, and repeatable engineering patterns.
* Serve as a highly capable technical contributor for Network AIOps platform engineering and operations.



  





**Interested candidates, share their resumes at g.punjabi@thesynapses.com or apply to this job post at the earliest.**

title: Copilot Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role combines mining\-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph\-based retrieval. environmental, and risk information.

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.

development within the team.
  
**Education**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.

description:

* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically and innovatively.

* Strong knowledge of **3D modeling, rendering, lighting, materials, and texturing**.

* **AutoCAD**
* **Photoshop**
* Good understanding of **interior design principles, space planning, materials, and furniture**.
* Ability to create realistic lighting and material finishes.
* Strong attention to detail and visual sense.
* Ability to understand technical drawings and architectural plans.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work on multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong creative and problem\-solving abilities.

* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in **Interior Design, Architecture, 3D Visualization, or a related field**.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in interior design visualization or 3D rendering.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio of interior projects will be preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* Residential interiors
* Modular kitchens and wardrobes
* Commercial interiors
* Retail and hospitality projects
* Furniture visualization
* Photorealistic architectural rendering
* 360° views and walkthroughs

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Quality and realism of 3D visualizations
* Accuracy of designs and dimensions
* Turnaround time for renders and revisions
* Ability to understand and implement design briefs
* Number of revisions required due to design/technical errors
* Coordination with the design and project teams
* Client satisfaction with presentation visuals

description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client\-centric and digitally\-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
   

  

**Job Function:**
 The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
   

  

 This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
   

  

 This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end\-to\-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high\-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
   

  

 The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.

description:

 Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
   

  

**Position Title:** 
 Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Insurance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)
* Vendor\-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)


**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**
* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery\-side credibility
* Platform\-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture: site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
* Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave: workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
* Own the Marketplace app gap analysis: Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
* Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
* Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
* Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
* Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
* Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
* Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
* Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
* Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.


**Preferred**
* Atlassian certifications (e.g., ACP\-level Jira administration).
* Experience in regulated industries where validation evidence and auditability matter.
* Exposure to SAFe\-aligned Jira configuration at scale.
