title: Technical Co-Founder And Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Guidzy is a travel technology platform focused on helping people explore India with faster, safer, and more personalized trip planning. The platform connects travelers with verified local guides, hotels, cabs, houseboats, activities, and authentic experiences through a single, trusted interface. Safety and trust are central, with features such as guide verification, ratings, reviews, location\-based matching, trip sharing, and SOS support. Starting in Kerala and expanding across India, Guidzy aims to build a nationwide local travel network that benefits both travelers and local businesses. Travelers of all types—solo, couples, families, groups, and international visitors—can use Guidzy to access reliable local support and truly “explore India like a local.”
   

**Role Description** 
 The Technical Co\-Founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will lead Guidzy’s technology vision, architecture, and product development from the ground up. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kerala, India, working closely with the founding team to build and scale a robust travel platform. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include defining technical strategy, overseeing system architecture, managing the development lifecycle, and ensuring platform performance, reliability, and security. The CTO will design and implement core product features, integrate third\-party services, establish development standards and processes, and build and mentor the engineering team. The role also involves collaborating with product, business, and operations teams to translate user needs into scalable solutions and iterate quickly based on market feedback.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to interpret user behavior, product metrics, and technical trade\-offs, and to drive data\-informed decisions.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate with founders, engineers, partners, and non\-technical stakeholders in a clear and inclusive manner.
* Sales\-related capabilities, including supporting product demos, engaging with early customers, and representing the technology vision in partner conversations.
* Marketing awareness to align product features with market needs, support go\-to\-market initiatives, and contribute to positioning and messaging for a tech audience.
* Research skills to stay current with travel\-tech trends, security best practices, and relevant tools, and to evaluate new technologies for platform growth.
* Proven experience designing and scaling web or mobile platforms (preferably marketplace or travel\-tech) using modern architectures and cloud infrastructure.
* Hands\-on expertise in backend and frontend development, APIs, databases, and performance optimization, with willingness to code in early stages.
* Experience building and leading engineering teams, setting development processes, and implementing QA, DevOps, and security standards.
* Ability to work on\-site in Kerala, India, and engage directly with local partners and users to understand ground\-level needs.

title: Project Architect
description:
**Company Description** 
 Green Home Properties is a multidisciplinary real estate, architectural, interior design, and engineering firm focused on delivering end\-to\-end solutions for housing and development projects. The company provides engineering services, executes real estate projects, and offers advisory support to clients across the property sector. With specialist expertise in structuring real estate transactions, Green Home Properties covers the full development lifecycle from concept and design through positioning and asset disposition. The team brings together experienced real estate professionals who focus on creating, improving, and repositioning assets for optimal value. Services include site identification and acquisition, best use evaluation, concept development, planning and building approvals, pre\-construction management, strategic real estate planning, and tailored sales and off\-take models.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Architect role at Green Home Properties is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. The Project Architect will lead architectural design and documentation for residential and mixed\-use projects, translating client requirements into functional and sustainable design solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing concepts and detailed drawings, coordinating Building Information Modeling (BIM) models, preparing and reviewing submittals, and ensuring designs comply with local codes and regulatory standards. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams, consultants, and contractors, overseeing design intent through all project phases from schematic design to construction administration. The Project Architect will also support LEED and other sustainability objectives, participate in client presentations, and help manage schedules and deliverables to keep projects on time and within scope.

* Strong architectural design and technical skills, with proficiency in Architecture fundamentals and building systems.
* Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows for design coordination and documentation.
* Ability to manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables, demonstrating solid Project Management capabilities.
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks such as Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) and interest in green building practices.
* Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating Submittals and construction documents with consultants and contractors.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp) and familiarity with local building codes and regulations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture from an accredited institution; professional licensure or progress toward licensure is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Experience in real estate development or interior design coordination is beneficial.

The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in architecture, design, visualization, and detailing, along with a willingness to learn and grow in a professional studio environment.

As a Junior Architect, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior architects and designers across various stages of projects — from **concept development and design to working drawings, 3D visualization, documentation, and site execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in architectural design development and concept preparation.
* Prepare plans, elevations, sections, working drawings, and presentation drawings.
* Develop and modify 3D models and architectural visualizations.
* Assist in material selection, detailing, and design development.
* Participate in site visits, measurements, and site documentation.
* Coordinate with senior architects, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Assist with project documentation and maintain organized drawing sets.
* Contribute creative ideas and design solutions during the development of projects.
* Support the team in ensuring design intent is maintained through the execution stage.

Requirements

* **Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch)** from a recognized institution.
* Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply; **0–1 year of experience** is an advantage.
* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD and SketchUp**.
* Familiarity with **Lumion, Enscape, Photoshop, Revit, or other visualization/design software** will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of architectural drawings, materials, and basic construction detailing.
* Strong visual and design sense.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work responsibly within deadlines.
* Most importantly, a **willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow with the team**.

What We Offer

* Exposure to a diverse range of architectural projects.
* Hands\-on experience in design, documentation, visualization, and site execution.
* A collaborative and learning\-oriented studio environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced architects and designers.
* Scope for professional and creative growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their **CV and portfolio** showcasing their academic, personal, or professional work.

title: Solution Architect- Infrastructure, cloud & security
description:
Role Overview:
 



  





 We are looking for a Solution Architect with strong Infrastructure and Azure expertise who can design secure, resilient and supportable solutions in a large, complex organisation.
 



  





 The essential focus of this role is infrastructure, cloud and networking architecture across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments. The successful candidate will be technically credible in Azure and infrastructure design, with sufficient networking depth to shape connectivity decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists. They will also be able to think beyond a single technology silo and understand the wider impact of their decisions across security, identity, integration, operations and business outcomes.
 



  





 Our technology estate includes SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Genesys and Azure\-based platforms. Direct experience across all of these platforms is not required, but the successful candidate should be comfortable working with architects and specialists across these domains.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong cloud and infrastructure knowledge with practical networking architecture experience, company\-wide solution thinking, sound judgement and curiosity about how different technology domains interact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead infrastructure and cloud architecture activities across a diverse technology landscape.
* Design secure, resilient and supportable solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Contribute to Azure strategy, cloud adoption and platform evolution.
* Define and assure networking and connectivity architectures across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments, working with network engineering and security specialists where detailed engineering expertise is required.
* Work closely with architects across SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration domains.
* Support enterprise identity, authentication and access management strategies.
* Contribute to security architecture discussions and ensure security is embedded into solution designs.
* Support architecture governance, roadmap development and domain stewardship activities where relevant.
* Help define infrastructure standards, patterns and architectural guardrails.
* Support enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives and cloud migration programmes.
* Consider operational supportability, resilience, disaster recovery and lifecycle management in solution designs.



  





**Essential Skills \& Experience:** 




  




* Strong Infrastructure Architecture experience.
* Strong Azure architecture experience.
* Experience designing solutions for large, complex organisations.
* Strong practical knowledge of on\-premises, cloud and hybrid networking architecture, including network segmentation, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, resilience and secure cloud access patterns. Deep specialist expertise across every networking technology is not expected, but candidates must be able to make sound architectural decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists.
* Experience working with identity and access management concepts.
* Ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience balancing technical, security, operational and business requirements.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.



  





**Highly Desirable** 




  





 The following areas are highly desirable rather than mandatory. We would not expect candidates to demonstrate deep expertise across all of them, but experience in some areas, combined with the curiosity and judgement to work effectively with specialists in the others, would be a strong advantage.
 


* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Understanding of Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with Conditional Access, Privileged Access and identity governance.
* Experience supporting enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow or Salesforce.
* Experience with security architecture and risk\-based design decisions.
* Understanding of integration and data architecture principles.
* Experience with cloud landing zones and enterprise governance models.
* Experience contributing to technology roadmaps and standards.



  





 The Type of Architect We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are seeking a strong Infrastructure and Azure architect who can think beyond a single technology silo.
 



  





 The successful candidate will understand that infrastructure decisions can impact applications, data, security, integration, operations and business outcomes. They will be comfortable working across architectural boundaries, collaborating with other domain specialists and helping shape solutions that are coherent across multiple technologies.
 



  





 Whilst Azure and Infrastructure will be their primary area of expertise, they will have a genuine interest in broader company\-wide technology considerations and an appreciation of how cloud, identity, security, integration and business platforms work together.
 



  





 Why This Role Is Different
 



  





 Many infrastructure architecture roles focus primarily on hosting, networking and cloud technologies.
 



 In this role, we are looking for someone who can combine deep Azure and infrastructure expertise with broader company\-wide solution thinking. The successful candidate will work alongside architects responsible for SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration and will play a key role in shaping secure, resilient and supportable end\-to\-end solutions.

Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.  

Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.

Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI\-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.).  

Customer Engagement \& Consultative Advisory

Provide architectural governance and ensure alignment with solution blueprint throughout delivery.  

Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling.  

Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment.  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration  

Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.  

Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

  

Technical Skills


Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.  

Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.


Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.  

Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.  

Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.  

Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).  

Business \& Leadership Skills  

Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.  

Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.

Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.

title: Technical Architect Salesforce
description:
**Company Description** 
 UniSense Advisory, founded in 2022, is a consulting firm specializing in cybersecurity services and business assurance. The company provides comprehensive solutions including intelligence, fraud investigation, security assessments, risk management, and compliance support. Its portfolio spans risk and assurance, cyber and resilience, business assurance as a service, and education programs such as cybersecurity courses and cyber ranges. Combining industry expertise with modern research methodologies, UniSense delivers practical, forward\-looking strategies that help organizations safeguard digital assets and maintain operational continuity. The firm emphasizes a holistic, client\-focused approach to addressing complex cyber risks and strengthening overall security posture.
 



**Role Description** 
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Architect** 
 specializing in
 **Salesforce Field Service (SFS)** 
 to lead the design, delivery, and continuous evolution of field service solutions for our managed services clients. This role blends deep technical architecture expertise with strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills. The ideal candidate will act as the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of clients — translating business requirements into scalable, well\-governed Salesforce solutions while overseeing ongoing support, enhancements, and platform health within a managed services model.
 



 This is a senior, solution\-focused role for someone who is equally comfortable designing complex technical architectures, leading solution workshops, mentoring delivery teams, and managing executive\-level client relationships.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Solution Architecture \& Technical Design** 



* Architect end\-to\-end Salesforce Field Service solutions, including Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning (FSL), scheduling optimization, mobile workforce enablement, and integrations with ERP, IoT, asset management, and inventory systems.
* Design scalable data models, sharing/security architecture, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, middleware) that align with enterprise architecture standards.
* Own the technical solution blueprint from discovery through go\-live, ensuring designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Salesforce best practices and the Well\-Architected framework.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical health checks, and org optimization assessments for existing managed services clients.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate Salesforce products/features (Field Service, Omni\-Studio, Experience Cloud, Einstein/Agentforce, CTI) to meet evolving business needs.
* Define and enforce coding standards, DevOps/release management practices, and technical governance across the managed services portfolio.



**2\. Managed Services Delivery** 



* Serve as the lead technical authority for a portfolio of managed services accounts, ensuring platform stability, performance, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee triage, root\-cause analysis, and resolution of complex technical issues escalated from support teams.
* Drive proactive roadmap planning, release management, and quarterly enhancement planning with clients.
* Manage technical debt, org complexity, and platform scalability over the lifecycle of the managed services engagement.
* Partner with project/delivery managers to scope change requests, estimate effort, and manage sprint/release backlogs.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and managed services governance frameworks.



**3\. Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for client stakeholders, from business users to C\-suite/IT leadership.
* Lead solution design workshops, technical discovery sessions, and architecture review boards with client teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant language for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Manage client expectations around scope, feasibility, timelines, and technical trade\-offs.
* Build long\-term, consultative relationships that support account growth, renewals, and expansion of managed services scope.
* Present technical roadmaps, health assessments, and strategic recommendations in client governance meetings (QBRs, steering committees).



**4\. Team Leadership \& Enablement** 



* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, consultants, and administrators within the delivery team.
* Review solution designs, code, and configurations produced by the team to ensure quality and adherence to standards.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution scoping, effort estimation, and technical proposal development (SOWs, RFP responses).
* Contribute to internal capability building, reusable assets, accelerators, and best\-practice documentation for Field Service engagements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of Salesforce implementation experience, with at least 3–4 years focused specifically on
 **Salesforce Field Service (FSL)** 
 .
* Proven experience working in a
 **managed services / support\-and\-enhancement** 
 delivery model (not just greenfield implementations).
* Demonstrated experience as a Technical or Solution Architect, owning end\-to\-end solution design and delivery oversight.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* Field Service core objects (Work Orders, Service Appointments, Resources, Skills, Scheduling Policies, Service Territories)
* Scheduling \& Optimization (complex scheduling policies, Optimization, Dispatcher Console)
* Salesforce Field Service mobile app configuration and customization
* Service Cloud (Omni\-Channel, Case Management, Entitlements/SLAs)
* Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and declarative automation
* Integration technologies (REST/SOAP, MuleSoft, Platform Events, middleware tools)
* Data modeling, security architecture, and sharing rules at enterprise scale
* Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements or accounts.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and DevOps/release management tools (Copado, Gearset, Flosum, or similar).



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Salesforce certifications:
 **Field Service Consultant** 
 ,
 **Application Architect** 
 or
 **System Architect** 
 ,
 **Sharing and Visibility Architect** 
 ,
 **Integration Architect** 
 , Platform Developer II.
* Experience with adjacent technologies: MuleSoft, Tableau/CRM Analytics, IoT integrations, asset/inventory management systems.
* Prior consulting or systems integrator (SI) background.
* Experience in industries with heavy field operations (utilities, telecommunications, manufacturing, healthcare equipment, energy).
* Familiarity with Salesforce Well\-Architected principles and Success Cadence / Signature Success programs.
* Experience contributing to pre\-sales, SOW development, or proposal writing.







**Key Competencies** 




**Solution Architecture** 




 Ability to design scalable, secure, maintainable Salesforce solutions aligned to business outcomes.
 



**Client Advisory** 




 Comfortable operating as a trusted advisor across business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
 



**Technical Leadership** 




 Guides and mentors delivery teams, sets technical direction, and ensures quality standards.
 



**Problem Solving** 




 Diagnoses complex, ambiguous technical issues and drives them to resolution under managed services SLAs.
 



**Communication** 




 Translates technical complexity into business value; strong written and verbal communication.
 



**Commercial Awareness** 




 Understands managed services commercial models, scope management, and account growth opportunities.
 







**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Client platforms are stable, scalable, and continuously improved under the managed services engagement.
* Clients view the Technical Architect as a strategic, trusted advisor — not just a support resource.
* Solutions delivered are well\-architected, reusable, and reduce long\-term technical debt.
* Delivery teams are enabled and mentored to deliver high\-quality work independently.
* Managed services accounts grow in scope and value over time due to proactive technical guidance.

title: Smart Metering Solution Architect
description:
**DIRECTOR OF TECHNICAL SOLUTIONS, INTERNATIONAL AMI** 




**Location \-Noida** 




 Experience \-10\+ Years
 



**Employment** 
 Full\-time, permanent
 



**Mandate split** 




 \~40% customer\-facing (pre\-sale technical, discovery, demo, PoC)
 



 \~40% product\-facing (market requirements to product management team)
 



 \~20% market intelligence \& technology landscape
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




**This role is not a post\-sale deployment engineer. Once a contract is signed and hardware is shipped, delivery coordination moves to the Regional Delivery Manager.** 




**This role is not a pure pre\-sales role with a quota. You are measured on the quality of technical pipeline built and the quality of product requirements delivered back to product management team.** 




**This role is not a product owner. You surface requirements; the product leadership team makes the call.** 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Essential** 



* 8–12 years of technical experience in smart metering, AMI, or energy technology — either at a meter OEM, system integrator, or utility/metering coordinator on the buyer side
* Deep working knowledge of at least one major certification or technical framework in smart metering— not theoretical familiarity but hands\-on experience with what the process actually requires
* Fluency in the technical language of AMI: DLMS/COSEM, HES/MDMS architecture, communications protocols (RF mesh, NB\-IoT, PLC, LTE\-M), meter accuracy classes, power quality measurement
* Cyber awareness — you understand secure communications in AMI, firmware integrity, key management, and at least one regulatory cybersecurity framework relevant to critical infrastructure or smart metering. You can hold a credible conversation with a utility's security team
* Ability to run a technical discovery conversation with a utility engineer— understand their architecture, identify gaps, and propose a technically credible solution
* Ability to write a technical requirements document that a product owner can work on
* Comfortable operating across cultures and time zones— the product management team is in India/SG, customers are across APAC and Europe
* Strong written and verbal communication — you translate between two technical worlds and both sides need to trust your accuracy



  





**Highly Desirable** 



* Experience with national type approval processes for smart meters— having been through a certification filing, even as a second engineer on the project
* Familiarity with SMETS2specification and DCC connectivity
* Experience with edge intelligence on embedded software platforms (e.g. Zephyr)
* Hands\-on experience with cybersecurity in critical infrastructure or smart metering— secure OTA, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, regulatory audit preparation
* Knowledge of HES/MDMS integration
* Exposure to ADB/World Bank\-funded AMI procurement — understanding of procurement compliance requirements for development\-bank\-funded tenders
* Mandarin or Bahasa useful but not required



  





**The Role** 




 This role has a dual mandate. You are the person who determines whether product can actually win in a specific market — and then ensures the product management teams receive clear, actionable change requests so they know exactly what needs to evolve.
 



  





**Customer\-facing(40% of the role)** 



* Run technical discovery with utility engineers, metering coordinators, and technical procurement leads



 — understand their needs for HES architecture, DLMS/COSEM requirements, communications network, billing data flows, and certification constraints
 


* Build the technical case for value proposition — translate KEI™,KMesh™ into language that a utility engineer or technical head understands and trusts
* Own the technical pre\-sale process: architecture workshops, reference calls, proof\-of\-concept scoping, demo execution
* Support RFP and tender responses on technical sections— accuracy class, communication protocol, cybersecurity posture, data format compliance by working with the product management team
* Hold credible conversations with utility CISOs and security teams on AMI cybersecurity requirements
* Build credibility with technical stakeholders — you are the reason a utility trusts product before the first meter is shipped
* Travel across international markets for key technical engagements — this is not a desk role
* Events and thought leadership
 
 \- Represent at technical industry forums, standards working groups, and utility engineering events as the company's subject matter expert — contributing peer\-to\- peer to the technical conversation, not leading with a commercial agenda. This includes regulatory working groups, metering and grid\-edge conferences, and customer\-hosted technical workshops.



  





**Product\-facing(40% of the role)** 



* Be translation layer between international markets and the product management teams in India/Singapore, capturing differing voltage profiles, data formats, cybersecurity obligations, and DER environments
* Identify certification and regulatory cybersecurity requirements for each target market and feed them into the Market Requirements Document (MRD)
* Deliver structured, prioritized Market Requirements Documents (MRDs) to the CPO and CTO – specific and actionable
* Participate in certification reviews and flag technical blockers before they become commercial risks
* Inform pricing and commercial decisions where current specifications fall short of market technical complexity



  





**Market intelligence and technology landscape(20%)** 




  




* Engage the market, track the technology landscape relevant to markets— where the market is heading. This includes: emerging standards and regulatory changes (new accuracy class requirements, updated cybersecurity mandates, DER integration rules) before they become public procurement criteria; competitor product developments; adjacent technologies gaining traction(BESS sub\-metering, EV charging infrastructure metering, data centre power monitoring); and shifts in utility procurement behaviour (what is moving from CAPEX to OPEX models, what financing structures are gaining traction via ADB/World Bank/JICA).
* Maintain a working view of TAM and SAM for product categories in each active market — not a financial model but a living sense of the addressable opportunity, how it is shifting (new mandates, new utility procurement cycles, competitor wins and losses), and where is under\- or over\- indexed relative to the opportunity. Flag material changes to the International President as they emerge rather than waiting for a quarterly review cycle



  





**Technical Context** 




 You need to understand — or be able to quickly learn — the technical requirements of the markets is entering across APAC and Europe:
 


* AMI standards: DLMS/COSEM protocol stack, IEC 62052/62053 accuracy classes, NEM12/NEM13 data formats, OBIS codes, HES/MDMS integration architecture
* Communications: RF mesh, NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, PLC — how each performs in different grid environments and what utilities prefer
* Certification frameworks: National type approval processes, EU MID/CE marking, SMETS2 specification — at least one in depth, others at working knowledge level
* Edge intelligence: Software\-defined meter platforms, OTA firmware update architecture, edge application deployment — specifically relevant to EI
* Cybersecurity: Secure communications in AMI (DLMS/COSEM encryption, TLS, certificate management, secure boot, OTA signing, key management), regulatory frameworks (SOCI Act, NIS2, NIST CSF, BSI SMGW security requirements), responding to utility CISO questionnaires, understanding data sovereignty and localization requirements
* DER environment: How high solar penetration, VPPs, dynamic tariffs, and BESS integration change what a utility needs from its metering infrastructure



  





**The Person** 



* You are genuinely technical and comfortable reading a DLMS/COSEM standard document or a cybersecurity framework, not just talking about them in abstract terms
* Communicate across personas— from ‘C’ level to the operator
* Commercially aware — able to translate technical solution to what will sell
* Structured thinker — your product feedback is specific, documented, and prioritized.
* Comfortable with ambiguity— you are joining a 0\-to\-1 international build.
* Comfortable to be boundaryless

* Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns

 Delivery \& Governance
   

  

 Builder Mindset

title: Director Solution Architecture
description:
**This role is for one of Weekday's clients**
 Min Experience: 10\+ years
   

  

 Location: Pune, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Director \- Solution Architecture** 
 to lead the architecture and delivery of complex healthcare technology solutions for strategic enterprise clients across the United States. This is a senior, client\-facing leadership role focused on designing scalable solutions, driving complex implementations, translating business and regulatory requirements into technology capabilities, and ensuring successful enterprise adoption.
   

  

 The role will work closely with senior client stakeholders, product, engineering, implementation, operations, and commercial teams. You will own solution architecture across the full lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through implementation, go\-live, optimization, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare domain expertise with enterprise architecture, implementation leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex operational requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Enterprise Solution Architecture**
* Own solution architecture for a portfolio of strategic enterprise healthcare accounts from initial discovery through implementation and steady state
* Understand complex client workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, regulatory requirements, and technology environments
* Design scalable, secure, and configurable solutions that address multi\-site, multi\-state, and multi\-payer requirements
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed solution architectures, workflows, integrations, configurations, and implementation plans
* Serve as the senior architectural counterpart to client technology, operations, finance, and business leadership
* Ensure solutions align with product capabilities, technical standards, security requirements, and long\-term scalability


**Solution Design \& Implementation**
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex enterprise implementations involving multiple locations, states, payers, workflows, and system integrations
* Define system configuration, integration dependencies, data flows, workflows, and implementation sequencing
* Work with implementation and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions are translated accurately into production\-ready solutions
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and opportunities for standardization early in the lifecycle
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, configuration templates, solution frameworks, and implementation playbooks
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring implementation challenges and addressing them at the platform or architecture level


**Healthcare Revenue Cycle \& Domain Architecture**
* Apply strong knowledge of US healthcare revenue cycle processes to solution design, particularly outpatient and professional billing environments
* Translate requirements related to payer rules, claims processing, denials, eligibility, payment posting, reimbursement, and revenue cycle workflows into scalable technology solutions
* Understand healthcare transactions and standards including 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, EDI, ERA, and payer enrollment
* Incorporate requirements related to CMS\-1500, UB\-04, claim edits, NCCI logic, modifiers, therapy\-specific billing rules, claim scrubbing, remit reconciliation, and payment workflows
* Evaluate regulatory and payer changes and assess their implications for product architecture, integrations, and solution design
* Identify recurring operational or billing issues and work with product and engineering teams to address root causes through platform capabilities rather than manual intervention


**Enterprise Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**
* Act as the senior solution architecture expert during enterprise sales pursuits, RFPs, discovery sessions, technical evaluations, and client presentations
* Lead solution discovery with prospective clients to understand business, operational, technical, and integration requirements
* Define what can realistically be delivered within existing product and technical capabilities and identify areas requiring customization or product enhancement
* Develop solution proposals, architecture approaches, implementation assumptions, integration strategies, and technical responses for enterprise opportunities
* Partner with sales and commercial teams to ensure technical commitments are accurate, achievable, and clearly documented
* Ensure requirements are captured effectively and handed over to implementation teams without unnecessary re\-discovery or ambiguity


**Product \& Technology Strategy**
* Translate enterprise customer requirements into actionable product and engineering requirements
* Partner with product leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on recurring customer needs, market requirements, and healthcare industry changes
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, configurability, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation and AI across healthcare workflows and revenue cycle processes
* Establish reusable architectural standards and patterns that enable faster implementation of future enterprise accounts
* Contribute to technical documentation, solution standards, architecture guidelines, and organizational knowledge repositories


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Work effectively across product, engineering, implementation, operations, sales, finance, compliance, and customer\-facing teams
* Lead through influence across cross\-functional teams without relying solely on direct reporting structures
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to solution architects, implementation teams, and other technical stakeholders
* Establish clear ownership, decision\-making frameworks, escalation paths, and delivery standards for complex solutions
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Architecture Governance \& Performance**
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and solution governance processes
* Review proposed solutions for scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, and maintainability
* Monitor implementation and solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, evaluate solution effectiveness, and drive improvements
* Ensure enterprise solutions meet agreed business outcomes, technical standards, and implementation timelines


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 12\-16 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, healthcare technology, revenue cycle technology, or related domains
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise healthcare solutions for large, multi\-site or multi\-state provider organizations
* Deep understanding of US healthcare revenue cycle processes, including professional billing, commercial insurance, Medicare/Medicaid, claims, denials, appeals, and payment workflows
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare interoperability and transaction standards, including EDI, 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, and ERA
* Experience leading complex implementations involving multiple systems, integrations, locations, states, and payer requirements
* Strong understanding of healthcare technology environments, including EMR/EHR, practice management, RCM, and healthcare SaaS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to independently lead executive\-level business and technical discussions with US\-based clients
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical architectures and actionable implementation plans
* Data\-driven and structured approach to problem\-solving, architecture decisions, and solution optimization
* Comfortable working with teams and clients across US Eastern Time Zone working hours


**Strong Preference**
* Experience with outpatient rehabilitation workflows, including PT, OT, or SLP billing
* Knowledge of therapy\-specific requirements such as the 8\-minute rule, therapy thresholds, KX modifiers, plan\-of\-care certification, and therapy modifiers
* Experience with multi\-state Medicaid or workers' compensation environments
* Experience working with healthcare SaaS, EMR/EHR, practice management, or RCM technology companies
* Experience in startup or high\-growth environments where architecture standards, implementation frameworks, and playbooks were built from the ground up


**Nice to Have**

* Pre\-sales, solutions consulting, technical sales, or product management experience

description:

 Director

 Viewer Experiences, X32

 Onsite, Bangalore

 Full time
   

  

**Job Summary:** 
 As a Director – Discovery, you’ll lead the engineering efforts behind some of the most critical systems in the user journey—tray ranking, page ranking, and core recommendation infrastructure. You will own and evolve the core platforms that drive personalization at scale, powering dynamic and contextual discovery experiences across the product.
   

  

 Your teams will be responsible for building large\-scale, low\-latency systems that determine what content a user sees on the homepage and across key surfaces. These systems directly influence engagement, retention, and satisfaction by surfacing the most relevant content for each user. You will lead and take full ownership of a cross\-functional team spanning Machine Learning, Data Science, and Engineering to define and drive the future of personalized experiences. Your work will push the boundaries of innovation in multi\-objective ranking, exploration strategies, and real\-time inference at scale
   

  

**About the team:** 
 At JioHotstar, the Viewer Experience (VX) org is at the heart of how millions discover, engage with, and fall in love with our platform. We own the end\-to\-end user journey—from first app launch to daily habit loops—across Search, Personalization, Watch Experience, Interactivity, and more. We blend world\-class engineering, ML, design, and data to deliver a seamless, personalized, and engaging OTT experience at massive scale. If you're passionate about building immersive, intelligent, and performant user experiences that delight a billion users, join us in shaping the future of streaming.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Lead and scale the Core Recommendations \& Surfaces team, owning critical systems that power retrieval, ranking, and core recommendation infrastructure for personalized experiences across the platform.
* Drive the technical strategy and roadmap for core recommendation platforms—optimizing relevance, exploration, and user engagement through scalable, low\-latency, real\-time systems.
* Architect backend services capable of serving hundreds of millions of users and handling massive concurrency spikes (e.g., 20x during live events) with sub\-second latencies.
* Partner with Product, UX, and Data Science to define, build, and experiment with personalization enablers and surface\-level improvements that impact discovery and engagement funnels.
* Elevate engineering standards by championing best practices in measuring model efficacy, observability, system resilience, latency optimization, cost efficiency, and experimentation velocity.
* Own and improve critical personalization metrics, such as engagement uplift, surface click\-through rates, diversity ,coverage, and precision/recall of ranked items.
* Foster a high\-performance culture centered around ownership, first\-principles thinking, rapid iteration, and a strong focus on end\-user outcomes.
* Hire, mentor, and grow a world\-class engineering team, driving career development and delivering robust, high\-quality, impactful systems.
* Create effective mechanisms to set goals for the team, create execution plans and track progress against those. You'll collaborate with other Developers, Program Managers, and tech support teams, in an agile environment to estimate and deliver objectives set together as a team.


**Skills and attributes for success:**
* Experienced in managing multiple software engineering teams running core AI/ML services and/or ML systems at scale
* Previous experience with hands\-on work and shipping products in an AI and/or ML domain, like recommender systems, NLP, information retrieval, relevance, ranking, or large language models.
* Strong track record previously as an individual contributor having engineered and shipped services \& features at scale.
* Expertise in any of the programming languages (Python or Java or Golang)
* Hands\-on architectural or distributed systems experience
* Experience with high scale databases \- MySQL, NoSQL (Scylla, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB)
* Experience using any major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for production applications
* Experience with CI/CD processes
* A strong track record of project delivery for large, cross\-functional, projects and bringing in and growing engineering talent
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences


**Preferred education and experience:**
 Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Machine Learning with 12\+ years of experience in software development and 4 years of experience in managing software development teams.
   

  

**About Us:**
 Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media \& entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

title: Solutions Architect (India)
description:
Who we are

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.  The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.
   

  

 We work with founders, C\-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at large global brands and platforms who are building financial services solutions with Stripe. We work closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Partners, Technical Account Managers Product, and Engineering teams to develop and execute on the account strategy for Stripe in market.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 You will be building trusted relationships with brand new founders to the C\-suite, and solving mission\-critical business challenges for our users. You will be building new business models and help expand existing ones with users of all shapes and sizes in the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support key technical engagements for Stripe in India
* Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering, and Head of Payments.
* Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep 3rd party integrations in play.
* Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in\-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations and solution demos.
* Bring understanding of the regional market to our Product and Engineering organizations by acting as the “Voice of the User” to bring insights, trends and opportunities to the leadership, product and engineering teams.

* Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits.

* Manage pre\-sales projects, coordinating proof of concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a similar customer\-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
* Effective group\-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
* Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
* Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Gather an in\-depth understanding of all of Stripe’s products and their applicability across diverse business models to beneficially cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**

+ Prior experience driving technical sales and supporting them and their customer’s unique requirements
+ Can read, write, and understand code in one to many programming languages
+ Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
+ Experience in systems design, building and deploying complex applications.
+ Passionate about learning and actively seeks out knowledge
+ Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
+ Strategic and creative thinker who can proactively identify challenges and maintain a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
+ Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended global teams to support our users.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

title: Senior R&D Domain Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R\&D Team Manager **What We Believe In**


ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.


We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, safety solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


In this role, we are looking for a Senior R\&D Software Engineer – Control Library Development to join our Energy Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the design, development, validation, and lifecycle management of AC 800M Control Libraries that power ABB's industrial automation and safety systems.


Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop reusable control software components, perform product validation, and ensure the delivery of robust, reliable, and standards\-compliant automation solutions while partnering with Product Management, Architects, Safety Engineers, Quality Engineering, and global R\&D teams.


This role is contributing to the Energy Industries – AC 800M Control Library Development, Testing, Validation \& Lifecycle Support organization in Bangalore, India.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**

* Design, develop, maintain, and validate AC 800M Control Library components, reusable function blocks, communication interfaces, and engineering modules while ensuring compliance with ABB engineering, quality, and functional safety standards.
* Perform impact analysis, product integration, regression testing, release validation, compatibility assessments, and root\-cause analysis to ensure reliable, high\-quality software throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Architects, Safety Engineers, Quality Engineering, and global R\&D teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions while participating in technical reviews, release readiness activities, and continuous product improvements.
* Drive engineering excellence by mentoring team members, adopting AI\-assisted engineering tools, promoting reusable engineering practices, contributing to innovation initiatives, and continuously improving software quality, testing effectiveness, and engineering productivity.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, software development, testing, validation, or functional safety engineering.
* Strong experience with ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, Control Builder M, IEC 61131\-3 Structured Text, and control library development, testing, validation, and lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of IEC 61508 Functional Safety, regression testing, integration testing, release validation, impact analysis, and product quality assurance methodologies is preferred.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Agile development practices, AI\-assisted engineering tools, and modern software engineering workflows is considered an advantage.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, mentor engineers, contribute to reusable engineering solutions, and drive innovation across product development activities.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with a commitment to engineering excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high\-quality industrial software.

**More About Us**
-----------------


ABB's Energy Industries business serves customers across hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation, water, and other process industries by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, safety, sustainability, and reliability.


Our R\&D organization develops next\-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, safety solutions, and digital engineering platforms that help customers optimize operations and accelerate their digital transformation. By combining deep domain expertise with advanced technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial automation.


At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to develop mission\-critical automation software, enhance functional safety solutions, and contribute to innovative industrial control technologies. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.


ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre\-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior Engineering Leader
description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Engineering Leader
### **Job Description**

**Job Profile: Director, Cardiology R\&D and Cloud Operations**

Compensation Grade: CG80 \| Function: Philips Cardiology Informatics R\&D


This Director\-level role provides strategic and operational leadership for Philips Cardiology Informatics R\&D, with accountability for software engineering leadership, cloud\-enabled product development, service and cloud operations, and lifecycle ownership of a large, regulated healthcare customer install base. The role is responsible for leading diverse and globally connected teams, aligning execution with business priorities, and ensuring that product creation, operational excellence, quality, regulatory expectations, and customer outcomes are delivered at scale.


**Role Purpose**
================

The leader will drive cloud operations and R\&D execution for cardiology solutions, including AWS\-based cloud platforms and services, while maintaining a strong focus on healthcare\-regulated product delivery, customer reliability, and operational continuity for an install base of up to approximately 5,000 B2B healthcare customers.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead software R\&D and cloud operations teams across cardiology informatics portfolios, ensuring cohesive execution across functions, sites, and global stakeholders.
* Own operational performance for cloud\-driven products and services, including reliability, scalability, service continuity, incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and maintain a healthcare\-regulated B2B customer install base of up to approximately 5,000 customers, ensuring high levels of customer trust, compliance, availability, and responsiveness.
* Translate business goals, customer and market needs, and technical strategy into multi\-year execution plans aligned with Health Suite Reference Architecture, cloud, DevOps, and platform modernization priorities.
* Provide oversight for planning, staffing, budgeting, expense prioritization, resource allocation, and execution governance across teams and programs.
* Influence product creation, software development processes, architecture decisions, and engineering practices to improve efficiency, quality, security, and regulatory readiness.
* Serve as a senior R\&D liaison with service, operations, quality, regulatory, commercial, and external stakeholder organizations to drive business outcomes and customer value.
* Lead talent management, succession planning, performance management, and leadership development for subordinate managers, architects, and technical leaders.
* Contribute to 2–3\-year operational planning and the 5\-year Strategic Plan of Record, shaping long\-term objectives and adapting strategy to evolving business and customer needs.

**Minimum Required Qualifications**
===================================

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent technical discipline. Minimum 18\+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent senior leadership experience with a Master’s degree, in software development, software design and architecture, testing, quality assurance, cloud operations, or regulated product development. Minimum 8\+ years of working experience in the healthcare domain is required.


**Primary Requirements**
------------------------

* Proven experience successfully leading cloud teams, preferably AWS\-based, with strong understanding of cloud\-native engineering, service operations, R\&D architecture, and DevOps operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to run cloud\-driven development and customer\-facing operations in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Experience delivering, managing, and sustaining a large B2B healthcare customer install base, up to approximately 5,000 customers.
* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, quality management expectations, FDA/MDR audit readiness, and software lifecycle controls for regulated medical or healthcare solutions.
* Domain exposure to cardiology and/or radiology workflows, clinical informatics, hospital operations, or adjacent healthcare technology environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

**Education**
-------------

Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or an equivalent technical or engineering discipline is preferred.


**Preferred Skills and Capabilities**
-------------------------------------

* Software Development Life Cycle leadership, including agile execution, architecture governance, design controls, verification, validation, and release readiness.
* Cloud operations leadership, including AWS, DevOps, service reliability, incident and escalation management, observability, resilience, and operational governance.
* Business acumen, strategic planning, portfolio management, budget management, resource planning, and stakeholder management across global functions.
* People leadership, including management through subordinate managers, technical leadership development, succession planning, performance management, and organizational capability building.
* Quality, regulatory, and audit readiness experience, including healthcare regulations, FDA/MDR expectations, risk\-based decision\-making, and regulated software delivery.
* Customer install\-base management, including operational continuity, lifecycle planning, customer escalation handling, and field feedback integration.
* Cardiology and/or radiology workflow understanding, including clinical informatics, enterprise healthcare environments, and customer usage patterns.

\#LI \#HealthcareInformatics
  

**How we work together**  

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  

**About Philips**  

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.


As a Solution Architect for our **IT/OT Security Platforms** you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future\-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our **OT Zero Trust Platform** enables secure IT/OT communication through identity\-based connectivity concepts, while our **OT Patch Management** enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production\-related devices.


**What we offer you**


At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well\-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

 **You'll make an impact by**


* You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.
* You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI\-driven use cases.
* You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.
* You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.
* You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.
* You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.
* You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.
* You enable data\-driven and AI\-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.
* You actively shape the journey to AI\-native OT security services
  

**This is how you'll win us over**

* **Education**: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.
* **Experience and Skills**:
	+ You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity\-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800\-207 and IEC 62443\.
	+ You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3\+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine\-to\-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.
	+ You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.
	+ You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3\+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.
	+ You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API\-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI\-ready platform design.
* **Ways of Working**:
* + You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.
	+ You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross\-functional environments.
	+ You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
* **Languages**: • Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.
  


You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!


**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.** At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

  


**About Us**

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

Facilitation \- Facilitates learning, group activities and group discussions. Uses a range of techniques to guide group sessions to appropriate and useful outcomes, in a constructive and timely manner.
Mentoring \- Provides a reciprocal and collaborative at\-will relationship for the purpose of the mentee’s growth, learning, and career development. Often there is an emphasis on organizational goals, culture, career goals, advice on professional development, and work\-life balance.

title: Applied AI ML Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Shape the future of software delivery by building applied artificial intelligence solutions that are secure, reliable, and measurable. Join a team that turns advanced methods into production capabilities used by real customers, with strong engineering standards and clear ownership. Bring your expertise in building distributed systems and grow your impact through high\-visibility work, deep technical leadership, and cross\-team collaboration




As an Applied AI ML Lead at JPMorgan Chase, you will architect, build, and operate trusted applied artificial intelligence capabilities used in production. You will partner with product and engineering teams to deliver workflow automation and retrieval\-based solutions that improve user outcomes. You will translate technical tradeoffs across quality, latency, cost, and controls into clear recommendations that accelerate delivery and measurable business impact.




In this role, you will focus on production engineering for applied artificial intelligence, including retrieval\-based question answering and tool\-enabled workflow automation. You will set engineering patterns that improve consistency and reuse across teams, while maintaining strong standards for security, access controls, and operational resilience. You will define how solutions are evaluated, monitored, and improved over time based on real usage and measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on role with significant influence through design leadership, reviews, and shared practices.


Job Responsibilities


* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery for applied artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions, from requirements shaping through production support.
* Architect retrieval‑augmented generation solutions, including data ingestion, content segmentation, embedding, indexing, retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Implement tool\-enabled, agent\-based workflows with orchestration, state management, retries, permissions, guardrails, and observability.
* Define evaluation strategies, including offline test suites, curated datasets, human review where needed, continuous evaluation, and telemetry\-driven monitoring.
* Build reusable engineering patterns and reference implementations that reduce duplication and speed delivery across teams.
* Drive reliability, performance, and cost outcomes through benchmarking, capacity planning, latency optimization, and post\-incident learning.
* Embed security and governance by design, including sensitive\-data\-aware handling, access controls, auditability, and disciplined release practices for models and prompts.
* Influence technical direction through clear design documents, design reviews, and pragmatic decision\-making aligned to partner needs and control requirements.
* Coach peers through pairing, feedback, and best\-practice guidance without direct people management.

description:

description:

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**Senior Manager, AI and Innovation( Salesforce exp is a must)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

**About the Role**
------------------

The AI Senior Manager operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a **Strategist** , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an **Orchestrator** , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.

* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.

* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.

**Delivery \& Governance**
--------------------------

**Builder Mindset**
-------------------

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.

* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.

* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**

* 13\+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.

* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.

* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.

* Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Exposure to multi\-org, multi\-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.

* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool\-use patterns.

Unleash Your Potential


When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
