Join us in helping leading Mechanical Engineer organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our offshore engineering team in India, supporting the development of automated mobile heavy equipment that removes humans from the dull, dirty, and dangerous jobs. In this role, you will apply industrial design thinking and strong real\-time 3D CAD skills to develop mechanical hardware from concept through production release. You will work closely with engineering, product, and manufacturing counterparts in the United States, contributing designs that balance form, function, manufacturability, and field durability.


**In this role, you will:**


* Develop mechanical designs from concept sketches through detailed 3D models, drawings, and production release.
* Apply industrial design principles — ergonomics, human factors, serviceability, proportion, and product aesthetics — to hardware that operates in demanding field environments.
* Build and maintain parametric 3D CAD models and large assemblies, working in real time within a cloud\-based CAD environment shared across geographies.
* Produce manufacturing\-ready detail drawings with GD\&T, tolerances, bills of material, and engineering change documentation.
* Apply design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) and design\-for\-assembly (DFA) principles to reduce part count, cost, and assembly time.
* Create concept alternatives, renderings, and design studies to support early decision\-making and design reviews.
* Develop enclosures, brackets, mounts, guards, covers, and operator\-facing hardware in sheet metal, machined, molded, and fabricated forms.
* Support prototyping, fit checks, and design validation, and incorporate feedback from testing and field use into subsequent revisions.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors on component selection, tooling feasibility, and manufacturing methods.
* Maintain CAD data hygiene, part numbering, revision control, and design libraries in line with team standards.
**Your Profile**

description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.

Must have

title: Solutions Architect - Business Transformation
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
 



  





 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is building a Corporate AI Transformation team, and you will be one of its few first members. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work closely with business, operations and engineering teams to identify high\-impact internal use cases and convert them into working AI solutions that run in production.
 



 This is not a traditional backend or application engineering role. You will operate like a builder, systems engineer, and product thinker rolled into one. You will take ambiguous business problems, break them into solvable workflows, design the agent architecture, and ship production\-grade internal tools. You will work with Arcesium's corporate systems, data assets, and AI tech stack to build agents and automations that reduce manual effort, improve decision\-making, and scale repeatable work. Success for this role isn’t just measured by shipping a prototype or completing a project, it’s measured by putting solutions into production and driving meaningful adoption and impact.
 



 The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, a builder’s mindset, and a passion for using AI to improve how work gets done. This is a high\-impact role for someone who wants to build AI solutions that meaningfully improve enterprise processes.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Partner with business and functional teams to find the opportunities: workflow automation, AI\-assisted decision\-making, and work that agents can take on.
* Understand complex operational processes across teams and convert them into structured problem statements, system designs, and technical workflows.
* Build agents, workflow automations, and internal applications on top of Arcesium's corporate data systems, and enterprise tools.
* Rapidly prototype using LLMs, agent frameworks, MCPs. Get something small in front of real users early and iterate on their feedback.
* Design agent architectures that complete business tasks reliably.
* Work with engineering, business, and security teams to take prototypes to move prototypes into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Evaluate build\-vs\-buy options for AI workflows and identify the right technical approach for each use case.
* Create reusable components, templates and playbooks that accelerate this work across the firm.
* Define the KPIs, measure the impact, and drive adoption.



**What you'll need** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience, with a track record of shipping systems that other people depend on.
* Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, data, and systems design.
* Experience building internal tools or automation systems for business teams.
* The ability to understand a platform quickly, build on top of it, and turn business context into reliable technical solutions.
* Systems thinking. You can hold a whole workflow in your head, see where it is structurally inefficient, and redesign it rather than automate it as it stands.
* A bias to ship iteratively. You get a thin version into real use, learn from it, and improve it, instead of waiting for a complete design.
* Credibility with senior business and technology leaders, and the ability to say hard things clearly to both.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You will pick your own problems as often as you are handed them.

title: AI Security Architect
description:
**Overview**
 The
 **AI Security Architect** 
 reports directly into the Information Security organization and is responsible for enabling the
 **safe, responsible, and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise** 
 . This role partners closely with all Infosec teams to design and implement effective security protections for AI\-enabled systems operating across RealPage’s applications, enterprise environments, and SaaS production network.
   

  

 In addition to shaping AI security architecture and controls, this position plays a key role in
 **accelerating the Infosec organization’s own use of AI** 
 . The AI Security Architect helps security teams responsibly integrate AI into their daily workflows to improve the speed, accuracy, and effectiveness of detection, investigation, mitigation, and incident response.
   

  

 This role combines security architecture, applied AI expertise, and hands\-on collaboration to ensure AI technologies are adopted safely while empowering Infosec teams to move faster and make better decisions using modern AI platforms.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and influence enterprise security architectures for AI systems , including security incident response , LLMs, agentic workflows, MCP servers, AI gateways, and supporting infrastructure across cloud and SaaS environments
* Partner across all Infosec teams (Security Engineering, AppSec, Red Team, CSIRT, IAM/IGA, AI Governance, Third\-Party Risk) to embed AI\-specific security controls, patterns, and guardrails into existing programs
* Lead AI\-focused threat modeling covering risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool use, agent autonomy abuse, data leakage, model inversion, inference attacks, supply\-chain risk, and non\-human identity misuse
* Define and advise on AI identity and access strategies , including machine identity, non\-human identity (NHI), agent identity, credential lifecycle management, and least\-privilege access for AI systems
* Guide secure implementation of AI guardrails , content controls, policy enforcement, and runtime protections across internally built and third\-party AI platforms
* Evaluate and enhance API and MCP security for AI services, including authentication, authorization, abuse prevention, observability, and integration with existing security tooling
* Perform and support AI red\-teaming activities , including agent abuse testing, prompt and tool\-chain manipulation, model and integration testing, and adversarial simulation using automated and manual techniques
* Accelerate Infosec adoption of AI tools , helping teams safely integrate AI into workflows for vulnerability management, detection engineering, incident response, threat analysis, and security operations
* Educate, mentor, and advise Infosec stakeholders on practical, secure uses of AI platforms and agents to improve speed, quality, and scale of security outcomes
* Contribute to AI security standards, documentation, metrics, and executive\-level reporting to advance the maturity of AI governance and security programs


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience as a technologist , including strong hands\-on engineering experience
* 5\+ years of information security experience , spanning architecture, application security, security engineering, red teaming, or incident response
* Direct experience securing AI/LLM systems , including threat modeling, control design, or hands\-on implementation
* Working knowledge of agentic AI development concepts , including tools, orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous workflows
* Experience with machine and non\-human identity , including service identities, workload identities, secrets management, and access governance
* Understanding of MCP and AI integration patterns , including secure deployment, authentication, authorization, and monitoring considerations
* Strong foundation in API security , including RESTful services, authentication protocols, abuse prevention, and observability
* Familiarity with AI guardrails, safety controls, and policy enforcement mechanisms
* Hands\-on exposure to AI red\-teaming tools or techniques (e.g., PyRIT , Promptfoo , Protect AI, or custom approaches)
* Knowledge of cloud and hybrid security architectures (AWS, Azure, SaaS platforms)
* Solid understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, workload identity, token\-based auth)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams and educate others


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on development experience building or securing AI applications using frameworks and platforms such as LangChain , LLM gateways, agents, or workflow automation tools
* Experience using or integrating AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Claude, Codex)
* Familiarity with CI/CD and automation platforms and integrating security controls into delivery pipelines
* Contributions to open\-source projects , personal GitHub repositories, or research related to security or AI
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GPEN, GWAPT , or similar (certifications valued but not required )


**Skills**
**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES**
* Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance security, usability, and speed
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving AI environments
* Ability to translate emerging AI risks into practical, actionable guidance
* High degree of integrity, sound judgment, and professionalism when handling sensitive matters

description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

What you’ll do Discover and shape the solution Run discovery workshops with client stakeholders, assess the current process, and frame the business problem as an agentic solution.Prioritise and shape use cases jointly with the client, then validate direction with a working prototype in days — followed by the production hardening that enterprise delivery demands. Build and integrate Design and ship single\- and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs, connecting into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication.Engineer the agent core: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration.Build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates, with guardrails so agent behaviour stays predictable, safe and repeatable. Prove and govern Run eval\-driven development: build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.Own AgentOps and DevSecOps — CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability, telemetry, IAM, secrets management, privacy controls and shift\-left security — with Responsible AI governance from day one.Take agents through architecture review, security sign\-off and release governance on the way to production, then hand over with clear documentation and knowledge transfer into managed service.Design human oversight into every agent: approvals, exception handling and escalation paths appropriate to the process being automated. Own the outcome Set a baseline with the client, agree benefit targets, and track cycle time, manual effort, accuracy, exception rate, cost\-to\-serve, adoption and compliance as the scorecard.Run a continuous feedback loop: feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design. Operate within HCLTech and the client Collaborate with account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams — the FDE role sits across both organisations, not apart from them.Keep internal alignment as tight as client alignment: follow HCLTech’s governance charter,and socialise and review the proposition with the wider SME cohort before committing the client to it.Look for the scaling opportunity in every engagement — where a pattern, accelerator or approach could extend across other domains within the Delivery Unit — and bring proactive proposals forward. Lead and mentor Set technical direction for the pod: run code and design reviews, mentor engineers, plan the work, manage delivery risk and raise the engineering bar.Stay ahead of the curve: adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Technology mandate Language Python — primary and mandatory; other languages and frameworks follow the engagement. For example in the ING context Java will be necessary. Frameworks Agent Development Kits (ADKs) — e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same. Models Multi\-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost. Interfaces Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards\-based APIs and secure auth for client systems.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

What you’ll bring (must\-have) Advanced Python engineering — idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code — on a solid software engineering foundation (design, version control, architecture). Other languages follow the engagement; Python is the core.Hands\-on agent building with at least one ADK (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel).Solid command of agent engineering: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP and multi\-agent orchestration.Eval\-driven development: designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability.Standards\-based integration and DevSecOps: APIs, secure authentication and authorisation, IAM, CI/CD, observability, resilience and AgentOps.Ability to conceptualise a business problem as an agent quickly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, client\-embedded settings.Client\-facing consulting skills: discovery facilitation, process assessment, use\-case selection, stakeholder management and executive communication.Comfortable working across account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams to get a solution to production.Responsible AI as a working discipline — applied throughout agent design, evaluation and production governance.Experience mentoring or leading small engineering teams.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

A day in the life A typical day blends client consulting with hands\-on engineering. It often starts alongside business and technology stakeholders — unpicking a process bottleneck, agreeing what a good outcome looks like, and shaping it into an agentic solution. From there the work turns practical: building or refining an agent, wiring it into client systems, reviewing evaluation results and production telemetry with the engineering pod, and working through security controls and Responsible AI checks as delivery issues surface.Throughout, there’s a leadership thread — setting direction for the pod and raising the engineering bar — alongside the constant balancing act of speed against enterprise\-grade quality: showing the client visible progress, measuring business impact, folding in user feedback, and turning what works into reusable HCLTech accelerators.

title: Architect — Design Management
description:
Architect — Design Management \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  





 A developer's design manager is not a practice's project architect. Own the drawing from the yield test at land stage to the set issued to site, for a platform breaking ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January — and make sure the masterplan that wins the deal is the one that gets built.
 



  





 A note before you read on. Team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the platform's current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  





 REPORTS TO: Head of Projects, or the CEO — Development Business until that seat is filled · DIRECT REPORTS: none; the consultant teams on every project are commanded by this seat · ASSET CLASSES: Grade A warehouses, logistics parks and industrial parks, PEB and RCC
 



  






 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  






 THE PROJECTS TEAM
 




 Vantrock designs and builds in\-house. The projects function owns the asset from the first block plan to the day an occupier takes possession, and design management owns the drawing across all of it. The function is being built now, the seat does not exist in this form anywhere in the market, and the person who joins it will decide what it becomes.
 



  






 DESIGN OWNERSHIP, NOT COORDINATION
 




 In a practice, the drawing is the product. Here it is a means, and the product is a park that leases, clears its approvals and gets built for the number it was underwritten at.
 



 Land is our largest single cost and the masterplan is where it is either monetised or wasted. A point of ground coverage, a badly oriented dock face, a late fire NOC — each costs more than the entire design fee. This seat finds the yield, proves it is compliant, and makes sure it survives contact with site.
 



  






 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 The platform breaks ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January and has 10 million behind it, across four cities and more than one state's development\-control regime. Every masterplan drawn this year will be built and leased for the next ten, approvals sit on the critical path in every state, and nobody owns them end to end today. This is the first design seat, and it sets the standards the portfolio is built to.
 



  






 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 1\. The yield test at land stage — ground coverage, FSI, setbacks, truck circulation, dock\-face orientation and phasing on every opportunity, and the block plan and area statement the land recommendation is made on.
 



 2\. The portfolio design standards — 17 m bay grid, 12\.5 m clear height, 1:7,500 sq ft dock ratio, 28\.5 m yard depth, office area, FM2 and TR34 floors, defended against anything that erodes usable area.
 



 3\. The approval path — state industrial authority, town planning, fire NOC, environmental clearance, factory and DISH, CTE and CTO, on a live tracker with a real critical path.
 



 4\. The GFC set — coordinated, construction\-ready, issued in a state where the site does not have to ask what was meant. Site RFIs are the measure, and are counted.
 



 5\. The consultants — architectural, structural, MEP, façade and landscape, appointed, driven and held to what they hand over.
 



 6\. Buildability and change control — clash resolution before issue, then the RFI and design\-change log, with cost and time attached before a change reaches site.
 



 7\. Customer fit and design\-to\-cost — occupier briefs turned into fast, priced design responses, and design worked to the estimator's budget, not around it.
 



  






 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 





 ESSENTIAL
 




 – 10–15 years in design management, most of it on industrial, warehousing or logistics assets, at a developer, or at a practice or PMC on that portfolio at project\-lead level.
 



 – Parks you have masterplanned yourself, with the numbers: site area, BUA, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Tested in a practical.
 



 – The full statutory approval path run end to end in at least one state, and a working knowledge of how a second differs. NBC 2016, state fire and DCR in daily use.
 



 – Green certification to IGBC or LEED Platinum standard designed in from concept, not retrofitted at approval stage.
 



 – AutoCAD at expert level; fluent reading of structural and MEP drawings, specifications and contract conditions; SketchUp and Adobe for options, massing and presentation output.
 



 – Warehouse and industrial building systems: PEB and RCC, FM2 and TR34 flooring, dock equipment, K115 and K160 sprinklers, OSID and FAPA fire detection, roofing, cladding, external infrastructure.
 



 – Design\-to\-cost as a habit, not a phase: quantified options, value engineering without losing the specification.
 



 – B.Arch, with Council of Architecture registration. Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 




 ADVANTAGEOUS
 




 – M.Arch, NICMAR or an equivalent construction\-management qualification. IGBC AP or LEED AP.
 



 – Revit and BIM for model\-based coordination rather than drawings with a model on the side. Power BI for approval trackers, drawing registers and design\-change dashboards.
 



 – Temperature\-controlled, cross\-dock or automation\-ready fit\-outs. Approvals in more than one state.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 – Not a practice seat: the drawing is not the deliverable, a park that leases and gets built is. Not consultant coordination: you appoint, direct and hold the consultants. Not a delivery seat: execution on site belongs to projects. Not the programme office: cost and schedule control across the portfolio sits there.
 



  






 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 – Developer side, with real decision rights. You can reject a consultant's set, hold a land recommendation, and refuse a change that has not been priced.
 



 – Every decision traceable. A yield option has an area statement behind it; a released drawing has a name against it.
 



 – The reporting is not your job. Trackers, registers, RFI logs and dashboards run on Vantrock Intelligence, built before we bought an acre.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, travel to every site.
 



 JUDGED ON FOUR STANDARDS, TOGETHER. Yield: BUA per acre, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Compliance: approvals on the critical path, NBC and fire, green certification. Buildability: coordinated GFC sets, minimal site RFIs. Customer fit: BTS response and occupier specification.
 



  






 COMPENSATION
 




 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely. Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives, confirmed in the offer.
 



  






 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat: fluent use of AI tools for option generation, code and drawing checking, research and presentation output, and building on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test runs at every level, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second. The design is ours, but consultants, PMCs and liaison agents are commanded by this seat — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to.
 



  






 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days, with two links: six questions answered by AI interview, about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV, and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there: a design conversation on a park you masterplanned, walked through in numbers; a three\-hour supervised practical on a real parcel with a real access constraint, a development\-control extract and an occupier brief, from which you produce an area statement, a block plan, two yield options with the trade\-off stated, and the approvals on the critical path; then two references, contacted directly.
 



 Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  






 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Architect — Design Management — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. Mandatory: a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application, though we read that too.
 



 – Your Yield Sheet — one row per park you masterplanned: state, site area, BUA, ground coverage, clear height, dock ratio, asset type, your role, and whether it was built. Template on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the design decision you have seen destroy the most yield on an industrial park, and the check you would build so it never survives to GFC. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read all that arrives that arrives with a Yield Sheet and a paragraph, properly, not skimmed.
 



  





 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 



 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock

title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a visionary and highly
 **technical AI Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Engineer** 
 to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI\-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
   

  

 Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* AI Architecture \& Custom Integration
* Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
* Build proprietary internal LLM\-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
* Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow\-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.
* Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
* Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high\-cost, low\-utility third\-party vendors.
* Implement predictive modeling to identify high\-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real\-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
* Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
* Cross\-Functional Efficiency
* Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI\-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
* Consult with Marketing leadership on AI\-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads\-to\-Revenue" funnel and "Best\-in\-Class" SaaS ecosystems.
* Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no\-code tools.
* Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
* Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.
* Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce).
* Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one\-time setup.
* Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD And QAD Redzone**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises.
   

  

 QAD Redzone helps to enable QAD’s vision for the Adaptive Enterprise. Labor productivity improvements directly impact efficiency. Productive and empowered employees increase the effective capacity of your plant and accelerate time to productivity for new employees giving manufacturers the agility to increase production beyond what was previously possible without having to invest in production equipment or new plants, and reduce the amount and impact of employee attrition. Empowered employees with a growth mindset take extreme ownership of challenges that impact their production goals, creating resilience in the face of disruption.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Manager, Software Tools Development
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2015074
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA is the world leader in GPU Computing. We are passionate about markets including gaming, automotive, vision, HPC, datacenters and networking in addition to our traditional OEM business. NVIDIA is also well positioned as the ‘AI Computing Company’, and NVIDIA GPUs are the brains powering Deep Learning software frameworks, analytics, data centers, and driving autonomous vehicles. We have some of the most experienced and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you are dedicated, forward\-thinking, and if working with hard\-working technical people across countries sounds exciting, this job is for you.
   

  

 NVIDIA is looking for a Software Test and Tools development manager to join the NVIDIA GPU SWQA Team! You will play an exciting role that allows you to manage world class SWQA team and take full ownership of developing automated tests and tools to support high quality product releases . These products are designed to accelerate professional workflow, advanced gaming and enterprise features. You will be involved in developing and implementing automation testing strategies, automation roadmap, for new and existing features to achieve “Zero Defect” goal.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Own all product release quality and work with the engineering team to define and execute project roadmaps, schedules, and deliverables. Manage project risk and mitigate, as necessary. Own providing strategy to automate software functionality, compatibility, security and performance quality coverage.
* Define and drive the overall test engineering strategy for our nvidia GPU products, establishing an engineering\-focused approach to quality encompassing design for scalable test frameworks, tools, and methodologies and lead product testing and engineering efforts across a full\-stack solution
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on various Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python \& C\# which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain.
* Prioritizing team assignments and efforts; Supporting and enhancing the QA methodologies to ensure delivery of predictable, high\-quality product releases
* Demonstrate the ability to translate organizational goals to SWQA deliverables
* Be hands\-on to assist in improving process and procedures within the team. Help streamline day\-to\-day operations, workflows and practices. Lead by setting example \- Be a hands\-on manager and develop next line of leadership within the team.
* Helping to define quality practices and metrics which serve as strong predictors for the post\-release customer experience; Building up appropriate manual and automated test inventories to drive efficiency and productivity across the organization
* Timely identification and mitigation of technical and non\-technical risks, helping the team remove impediments; Communicating the status and key quality metrics to leadership teams, and help drive improvement as necessary
* Engage closely with a range of cross functional teams including project management, hardware and software developers, and routinely share statistical data reports.
* Ability to organize and motivate a team, analyze and resolve risks, execute a project plan and communicate status accurately


**What We Need To See**
* BE / BTech / ME / MTech / MS or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ overall years of experience with 5 years of leading and automation test and tools development teams.
* 5\+ years’ experience in core programming languages such as Python/C/C\+\+/Java/Selenium, should have thorough understanding of popular test automation architectures and the best industry practices.
* Prior experience as a technical manager; building and leading more than one project in parallel; with a growth mindset and outcome focused orchestration of deliverables.
* Expert in Windows and Linux OS fundamentals and configuration knowledge – Kernel, Networking, Windowing Systems, Commands and Utilities.
* Prior experience of crafting test plans for New Features and experience in device driver validation
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in software automation and manual testing and share your knowledge with the team.
* Experience in working with device driver and ability to translate organization goals into QA goals and good written and verbal communication skills \- concisely articulate knowledge and ideas.
* Excellent analytical skills for triaging, fixing and resolving issues and excellent command on data analysis and reporting; with experience in building Management Information Systems.
* Exposure on utilizing AIML and Agentic AI for accelerating and bringing efficiency in Development and QA workflows
* Ready to work onsite from Pune\-India.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience in leading team of Automation and Manual QA Engineers.
* Background with using AI Tools in Development and QA workflow
* Experience implementing automation for system software/SOC products.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU hardware, Graphics and Display Concepts – Geometry, Transform, Lighting, Rasterization, Occlusion, Texture \& Filtering, Anti\-Aliasing, Composition, Refresh Rates, V\-Sync, Frame Buffer, Overlays, Display Timing Parameters, Display Heads, OpenGL, GSYNC, DLSS.

description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way.  AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. The reviews on here paint many stories of successes, failures, excitement and disappointment. Every person has their own story. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.

* Engaging the Senior Executive Level of customer organizations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their Digitalization journey
* Supporting the Regional Solution Consultants with Domain Expertise and material to enable them to operate independently in Metals \& Mining.

* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech reach in Metals \& Mining to improve pipeline and awareness.
* Training \& educating Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on how to best engage Metals \& Mining customers, in their specific regions.
* Present AspenTech solutions at major trade\-shows and events, globally

* 10\+ years of experience in Metals \& Mining Industry selling software solutions
* Engineering Degree preferred
* Experienced in all aspects of the Metals \& Mining Industry, best practices and processes
* Proficiency in one or several AspenTech Solution areas, particularly Asset Performance Management, Advanced Process Control, Digital Twins, Data Historization, Engineering
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in solutions and industry

* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognized value for customers.

title: Principal Engineer – Application Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Principal Engineer – Application Architect
Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

Overview  

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment\-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams.  

Roles and Responsibilities  

* Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network services.
* Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross\-cutting issues.
* Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction.
* Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
* Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams.
* Communicate architecture trade\-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.

  

Essential Skills  

* Extensive software architecture and development experience in large\-scale systems.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event\-driven architecture, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production\-readiness practices.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


All About You  

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams.
* Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large\-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross\-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services.
* Experience designing and implementing multi\-region resiliency architectures, including active\-active and active\-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross\-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions.
* Champions operability and maintainability as first\-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self\-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception.
* Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large\-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams.
* Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization.
* Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* **Risk, Security \& Regulatory Governance:** Ensure all engineering practices and deliverables strictly adhere to HSBC security baselines, architectural governance, data privacy mandates, and financial regulatory requirements.

 **What you will need to succeed in the role**:

* **Academic Background:** University graduate with a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related STEM field from a top\-tier institution.
* **Domain Knowledge \& Regulatory Awareness:** Strong business domain knowledge in Retail Banking, Wealth Management, or Financial Services, including deep familiarity with financial security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards.

* **Deep Hands\-on Technical \& Full\-Stack Expertise:** Strong, active hands\-on background across full\-stack engineering (modern frontend frameworks, microservices, enterprise Java/Kotlin/Node/Python, distributed databases, cloud architecture e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure, API gateways, and event\-driven architectures), with the proven ability to review code, debug complex production issues, and guide deep architectural decisions.
* **AI \& GenAI in Engineering:** Demonstrable hands\-on experience in pioneering GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM\-based coding agents, automated QA/DevOps agents) to elevate engineering productivity and delivery velocity. Practical expertise and strong enthusiasm for AI\-driven engineering transformation; automated testing/DevSecOps pipelines, and modern agile engineering methodologies (CI/CD, TDD/BDD, GitOps).
* **Extensive Engineering Leadership \& Delivery Track Record:** Substantial experience in senior software engineering leadership roles, with a demonstrable track record of successfully delivering large\-scale, mission\-critical retail banking or enterprise software platforms from concept to production.
* **Performance \& Metrics\-Driven Mindset:** Demonstrated experience utilizing DORA metrics, telemetry, and engineering dashboards to drive measurable enhancements in team productivity, deployment frequency, and software quality.

title: Sr. Pricipal, Architect Solutions
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Sr Principal Solution Architect**

**Location:** Pune


Job Description AND PrinciplE Responsibilities


Senior Solution Architect will architect and guide delivery of solutions that meet strategic and tactical needs across channels and platforms. Will own the technical roadmap, manage technical risks, ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, and partner with engineering and security teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Senior Solution Architect is also responsible to design technical roadmap and processes. Design and develop change resilient application code and execute robust and effective testing. Manage project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters with a product mindset. Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance.


Key Responsibilities


Architecture \& Solution Design

* Architect solutions to meet strategic/tactical technical needs; drive end\-to\-end solution design for initiatives and enhancements.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements are incorporated into overall solution architecture (e.g., reliability, performance, maintainability, supportability).
* Define interactions between systems/components to optimize functional coverage and integration.


Roadmap, Risk \& Standards

* Create and maintain a technical capability roadmap; own technical risks and mitigation approaches associated with features and technologies.
* Ensure alignment with architectures defined within the division and across the enterprise; ensure enterprise technical standards are met.
* Evaluate technologies/products/solutions and recommend introduction, retirement, or phase\-out aligned to roadmap and enterprise direction.


Security \& Governance

* Coordinate and address security architecture requirements in partnership with enterprise security teams.
* Support governance/approval readiness by ensuring architecture diagrams reflect implemented reality; ensure monitoring/logging posture and enterprise pipeline usage evidence is in place when required.


Engineering Leadership \& Collaboration

* Lead developers in creation/review of new or enhanced software and provide technical guidance through design and implementation decisions.
* Engage business partners to understand requirements; translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Business Architects/Product teams to ensure technical architecture supports business objectives.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure technical standards are defined (as needed) and implemented by the multiple Agile teams in accounting

**Qualifications/ Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 15\+ years of significant experience in solution architecture and delivery in complex environments (multi\-team, cross\-functional).
* 5\+ years in Finance domain, 2\+ in Investment domain within Finance. Custody domains experience a huge plus

**Core Skills**

* Strong solution design skills across application/integration/data/platform layers; ability to make tradeoffs and drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, decision\-making, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks under timelines.
* Ability to drive alignment to enterprise standards and ensure maintainability/supportability of solutions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Experience in modern delivery methods (Agile) and guiding engineering teams through architecture and design decisions.
* Proven skills in building massive scale Cloud Native streaming apps that are resilient and elastically scalable and have built\-in redundancy.
* Experience coordinating security architecture and compliance expectations for enterprise solutions.

**Experience in tech stacks**

* Experience in programming languages (preferably Java) with hands\-on coding
* Experience in Azure Cloud, Terraform. Microservices (Container, Docker, Kubernetes, Cosmos DB), Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Warehouse, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL.
* Azure DevOps \- GIT, CI/CD Pipeline / GitActions
* Azure Security and Governance \- Manage Identity, SAS, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Application Gateway, Application Security Group, Web App Security, Dynamic Data Masking
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills with strong interpersonal and team management skills

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Site Supervisor
description:

\- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

\- Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

description:

Vdoit is looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Technical Architect – AI** to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high\-performance technology solutions.

* Design and define scalable, secure, and high\-performance application architectures.
* Lead technical architecture and solution design for new and existing products.
* Evaluate and implement **AI/ML and Generative AI** capabilities into business applications.
* Design AI solutions using **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI APIs, and prompt engineering**.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define technical solutions.
* Create architecture documents, technical specifications, system diagrams, and technology roadmaps.
* Define and enforce best practices related to coding, architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Design and integrate **REST APIs, microservices, third\-party APIs, and cloud services**.

* Troubleshoot complex technical and architectural challenges and provide long\-term solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **5–10 years of experience** in software development, solution architecture, or technical architecture.
* Strong understanding of **System Design and Software Architecture**.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more programming languages such as **Python, Java, Node.js, .NET, or similar**.
* Strong understanding of **AI/ML and Generative AI** concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with **LLMs, OpenAI/Gemini/Claude or similar AI APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering**.
* Strong knowledge of **REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed systems**.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud**.
* Good knowledge of databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis**, or equivalent.
* Understanding of **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, and DevOps practices**.
* Strong understanding of **application security, authentication, authorization, and data protection**.
* Experience integrating third\-party services and APIs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building **AI\-powered enterprise applications**.
* Experience with **LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases**, or similar AI frameworks.
* Knowledge of **AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI**, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Experience with **AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or multi\-agent architectures**.
* Experience designing **high\-availability and highly scalable systems**.
* Knowledge of **cloud\-native and serverless architectures**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to take ownership of architecture and technical decisions.
* Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly **AI and Generative AI**.

**Education**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **AI\-driven and next\-generation technology solutions**.
* Exposure to modern **cloud, software architecture, and Generative AI technologies**.
* Opportunity to work with a collaborative and innovative technology team.
* Career growth and leadership opportunities.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Test Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in test automation, quality engineering, and test architecture, gained through over 15 years of hands\-on experience at an enterprise scale. The candidate should have a strong background in designing and implementing shift\-left testing strategies that integrate quality controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.


Hard skills include proficiency with test automation frameworks, specifically Selenium and Playwright, applied to both API and UI testing. The candidate must demonstrate practical experience in utilizing AI and generative AI technologies to enhance engineering and testing workflows, such as AI\-assisted test case creation, specification\-driven testing, intelligent coverage analysis, and automated test review. Additionally, expertise is expected in managing test data strategies, test environments, and service virtualization within complex, multi\-system architectures. The role also involves defining and managing quality gates, coverage metrics, and test\-effectiveness KPIs within agile and DevOps frameworks.


Soft skills entail strong technical leadership capabilities, with proven ability to influence and align engineering, delivery, and architecture teams without direct authority. Effective communication skills are essential for articulating testing strategies, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Strong hands\-on experience with CXL and/or PCIe protocols.
* Strong experience with Verilog/VHDL and RTL design.
* Experience with Intel/Altera and/or AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools and design flows.
* Experience with functional simulation, FPGA debug, synthesis, and timing analysis.
* Experience integrating FPGA with hardware and software.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies and protocols.

Defines a robust CXL\-first FPGA architecture and personally delivers critical RTL/features; enables clean hardware/software integration and platform bring\-up; and raises team capability through technical leadership, mentoring, and hands\-on resolution of difficult system issues.
