title: Senior Architect
description:
1\. POSITION PURPOSE

The Senior Architect will provide senior\-level architectural leadership and project ownership across multiple projects, from conceptualization and design development through detailed documentation, coordination, and construction support.

The position is responsible for ensuring design excellence, technical quality, statutory compliance, timely project delivery, client satisfaction, and effective team performance.

The Senior Architect will act as a key link between the Lead/Principal Architect, design team, consultants, project team, clients, contractors, and statutory authorities.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Design Leadership \& Architectural Development

Lead the architectural design process from concept stage through detailed design and execution.

Develop and review design concepts, planning strategies, space planning, elevations, sections, details, and presentations.

Translate client requirements, project objectives, and functional requirements into effective architectural solutions.

Provide strategic design direction to Architects and Junior Architects.

Review design alternatives and recommend practical, economical, and technically feasible solutions.

Maintain the architectural vision and design intent throughout the project lifecycle.

Ensure consistency of design quality across multiple projects.

Take responsibility for resolving complex architectural and design challenges.

B. Project Ownership \& Delivery

Take overall responsibility for assigned architectural projects and deliverables.

Establish project design priorities, deliverables, and internal timelines.

Monitor progress against project schedules and ensure timely submission of deliverables.

Identify potential delays, design risks, coordination issues, and resource requirements at an early stage.

Coordinate with the Project Head to ensure architectural activities remain aligned with overall project objectives.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Ensure proper handover and continuity between design, documentation, and site execution stages.

C. Client Management \& Stakeholder Coordination

Act as a senior point of contact for clients on architectural matters.

Understand and evaluate client requirements and provide professional recommendations.

Lead design presentations and client review meetings.

Manage client feedback, design revisions, and approvals.

Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, PMC teams, and government authorities.

Represent the organization in important project meetings when delegated by the Lead/Principal Architect.

Handle sensitive design, coordination, and project\-related discussions professionally.

D. Multidisciplinary Coordination

Lead coordination with Structural, Electrical, HVAC/MEP, Landscape, Interior, Fire \& Safety, and other specialist consultants.

Review multidisciplinary drawings and identify clashes, discrepancies, and design conflicts.

Ensure architectural requirements are properly incorporated into other consultants' designs.

Coordinate with estimation and project teams for design\-related requirements.

Provide timely architectural inputs to the Project and Estimation teams.

Participate in technical coordination meetings and ensure closure of outstanding issues.

E. Technical Review \& Quality Control

Conduct detailed technical reviews of architectural drawings and documentation.

Review working drawings, construction details, schedules, specifications, and material proposals.

Ensure drawings are technically accurate, coordinated, and suitable for construction.

Establish and maintain architectural documentation and quality standards.

Review drawings prepared by Architects and Draftsmen before submission/issuance.

Ensure compliance with applicable NBC, local development regulations, building bye\-laws, fire regulations, accessibility standards, and statutory requirements.

Identify design and documentation errors before issue to clients, consultants, or contractors.

F. Construction \& Site Support

Provide senior\-level architectural guidance during construction.

Conduct regular site visits as required by project requirements.

Review site conditions and provide appropriate architectural solutions.

Resolve technical queries raised by contractors and site teams.

Review shop drawings, material samples, mock\-ups, and construction details.

Monitor execution against approved architectural drawings and design intent.

Coordinate with the Project/Site Team for timely resolution of architectural issues.

Provide recommendations on variations, substitutions, and design modifications where required.

G. Team Leadership \& Resource Management

Lead, supervise, and mentor Architects, Junior Architects, Intern Architects, and Draftsmen.

Allocate work according to project requirements, individual capabilities, and deadlines.

Review team performance and deliverables at regular intervals.

Provide technical guidance and develop the capabilities of junior team members.

Establish efficient workflows for design development and documentation.

Monitor team workload and coordinate resource requirements with management.

Promote accountability, collaboration, and professional standards within the architecture team.

Conduct knowledge\-sharing and technical review sessions where required.

H. Design Standards \& Process Development

Develop and maintain standardized architectural drawing and documentation practices.

Improve internal design, coordination, and review processes.

Establish checklists for design and drawing quality control.

Ensure proper version control and documentation of design revisions.

Introduce efficient methods to improve productivity and reduce design/documentation errors.

Support management in developing architectural standards and internal design guidelines.

I. Commercial \& Project Coordination Support

Provide architectural inputs for project estimates, BOQs, specifications, and tender documentation.

Coordinate with the Commercial/Estimation Team regarding design changes and their cost implications.

Review scope changes and provide technical inputs for variation proposals.

Support management in evaluating design options from technical, functional, quality, and cost perspectives.

Assist in preparing technical proposals and presentations for new projects and tenders when required.

J. Business Development \& Pre\-Tender Support

Support the Lead/Principal Architect in architectural proposals, tenders, EOIs, and presentations.

Contribute to project feasibility studies and preliminary design proposals.

Assist in preparing design narratives, project presentations, and technical submissions.

Participate in client presentations and pre\-bid discussions when required.

Provide professional inputs for developing new project opportunities.

3\. AUTHORITY \& DECISION\-MAKING

The Senior Architect will be expected to:

Take ownership of architectural decisions within assigned projects.

Approve/recommend design and technical solutions within delegated authority.

Review and recommend architectural drawings before final approval.

Allocate and monitor work within the architecture team.

Escalate major design, commercial, contractual, or project risks to the Lead/Principal Architect.

Ensure that critical architectural decisions are properly documented and communicated.

Take responsibility for the quality and timely completion of assigned architectural deliverables.

4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Timely delivery of architectural milestones and deliverables.

Quality and accuracy of architectural drawings and documentation.

Effective multidisciplinary coordination.

Successful resolution of design and site\-related issues.

Client satisfaction and quality of client communication.

Team productivity and performance.

Effective management of multiple projects.

Reduction in drawing errors, rework, and coordination issues.

Compliance with statutory requirements and project standards.

Contribution to project profitability, efficiency, and successful delivery.

Development and mentoring of the architecture team.

5\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Educational Qualification

B.Arch. – Bachelor of Architecture from a recognized institution.

M.Arch. / specialization in Architecture, Urban Design, or related field will be an advantage.

Professional Registration

Council of Architecture (COA) registration preferred/required as applicable.

Experience

15–20 years of relevant professional experience in architectural design and project delivery.

Proven experience in independently handling medium to large\-scale projects.

Experience in government, institutional, commercial, residential, infrastructure, or public\-sector projects will be an advantage.

6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES

Technical

Advanced knowledge of architectural planning and design.

Strong understanding of building construction and detailing.

Knowledge of statutory regulations and approval processes.

Strong multidisciplinary coordination skills.

Excellent understanding of construction documentation and site execution.

Leadership

Strong team leadership and people\-management skills.

Ability to mentor and develop architects and junior team members.

Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities.

Ability to manage priorities and multiple projects.

Client \& Communication

Excellent verbal and written communication.

Strong presentation and client\-handling skills.

Ability to confidently communicate technical matters to non\-technical stakeholders.

Strong negotiation and coordination skills.

Software

AutoCAD

Revit/BIM

SketchUp

Adobe Creative Suite

MS Office

Other relevant architectural/design software

7\. EXPECTED PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

The Senior Architect should demonstrate:

Ownership \& Accountability

Leadership \& Team Development

Design Excellence

Technical Competence

Client Orientation

Strategic Thinking

Problem Solving

Attention to Detail

Time \& Project Management

Professional Integrity

Collaborative Working Style

8\. ROLE EXPECTATION

The Senior Architect is expected to function not merely as a design professional but as a project and design leader, capable of independently managing architectural responsibilities, guiding the architecture team, coordinating multidisciplinary consultants, handling senior\-level client interactions, and ensuring successful delivery of projects in line with the organization's quality, design, commercial, and timeline objectives.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Manager – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) – Informatica Solution Architect
description:
As the Informatica Architect you will architect, design, lead and govern enterprise data management solutions using Informatica Master Data Management (MDM), Reference Data Management (RDM), Data Quality (IDQ), and Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC). You will define target\-state data architectures, establish reusable data management patterns, guide implementation teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and trust across the enterprise.  

Key job responsibilities:* Define enterprise architecture and implementation roadmaps for Informatica MDM, RDM, IDQ, and CDGC.
* Design employer, employee, services, projects and other domain\-specific master data solutions.
* Develop MDM models, hierarchies, relationships, match\-and\-merge rules, survivorship strategies, and trust frameworks.
* Design reference data structures, mappings, crosswalks, validation rules, and stewardship processes.
* Establish data quality rules, profiling standards, scorecards, exception management, and remediation workflows using IDQ.
* Design data quality reporting solution for batch and event\-driven inbound data.
* Configure and govern metadata harvesting, lineage, glossary, classification, ownership, and catalog capabilities in CDGC.
* Integrate Informatica platforms with operational applications, data lakes and AI solutions.
* Define batch, real\-time, event\-driven, and API\-based integration patterns.
* Establish standards for data governance, security, privacy, access control, and auditability.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution design sessions, technical estimations, and implementation planning.
* Produce architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data models, design standards, and operational runbooks.
* Guide developers, data engineers, analysts, and data stewards.
* Troubleshoot complex performance, integration, matching, metadata, and data quality issues.
* Support testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Drive reusable frameworks, automation, and continuous improvement across Informatica implementations.
  

Required Qualifications* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in master data management, data quality management and data catalogs.
* 6\+ years of designing and architecting data management solutions using Informatica.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Informatica MDM, Reference Data Management, Data Quality, Cloud Data Governance and Catalog
* Experience designing multi\-domain MDM solutions and enterprise data governance operating models.
* Strong understanding of match\-and\-merge, survivorship, hierarchy management, data stewardship, and data certification.
* Experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud or comparable cloud\-based data platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL, relational databases, data modeling, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Informatica data management with platforms such as Redshift and Databricks.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, access management, and regulatory data controls.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and communicating with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience with other MDM, DQM and Data Catalogs technologies.
* Experience with Global Mobility, HR, tax, immigration, payroll, finance, or professional services data.
* Experience managing data across multiple jurisdictions, and regions.
* Knowledge of enterprise metadata, lineage, business glossary, reference data, and data catalog strategies.
* Familiarity with privacy, security, retention, and access\-control considerations for sensitive personal data and knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, etc.
* Experience with event\-driven data distribution, APIs, messaging, or publish/subscribe architectures.

title: Data Solution Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Data Solution Architect to design and implement scalable, cloud\-native data solutions across both OLAP (analytical) and OLTP (operational) architectures, applying advanced data management and governance practices within a large\-scale banking environment. This role provides technical leadership on modern data platforms — spanning Data Lakes, Operational Data Stores, real\-time streaming, and Data Mesh — ensuring solutions are secure, performant, cost\-optimised, and aligned with enterprise data strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep data engineering expertise with architectural vision, working across business, data engineering, and analytics teams to deliver data solutions that support both operational excellence and advanced analytics use cases.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design Data Lake and Operational Data Store architectures using cloud\-native technologies to support both analytical (OLAP) and operational (OLTP) workloads, ensuring proper separation, scalability, and performance.


Define and enforce Data Mesh principles for decentralized data ownership and governance, establishing domain\-oriented data products, self\-serve data infrastructure patterns, and federated governance.


Develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases, ensuring models are well\-documented, fit for purpose, and aligned with enterprise data standards.


Design batch and real\-time data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies, ensuring reliable, low\-latency data flow from source systems to Data Lakes, ODS, and downstream consumers.


Build and manage scalable ETL/ELT processes for data cleansing, validation, transformation, and enrichment across multiple source systems including core banking, payments, and transaction banking platforms.


Define patterns for data pipeline orchestration, error handling, retry logic, and monitoring to ensure production\-grade reliability and observability.


Utilize AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, Airflow, and SageMaker to deliver end\-to\-end cloud\-native data solutions aligned with security, cost optimization, and scalability principles.


Support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases by designing data pipelines and platform capabilities that provide governed, high\-quality data to data science and business intelligence teams.


Implement data quality frameworks incorporating validation, profiling, and anomaly detection to ensure data trustworthiness.


Establish and maintain metadata management and data lineage tracking to provide transparency into data origins, transformations, and usage.


Define data standards, policies, and best practices collaboratively with data owners, compliance, and business stakeholders to align with regulatory and governance frameworks.


Collaborate with data product owners, data engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define data products, and deliver solutions driving measurable business value.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in data architecture and engineering within large\-scale enterprise settings, focusing on designing and implementing complex data platforms. The candidate should demonstrate practical knowledge of data lake, Operational Data Store (ODS), and Data Mesh architectures, employing these frameworks to develop robust production environments. Proficiency in crafting and optimizing data pipelines is essential, including batch and real\-time processes for ingestion, cleansing, validation, transformation, and modeling.


Hard skills include a deep understanding of real\-time streaming technologies, particularly Apache Kafka, covering topic design, partitioning, consumer group management, and integration with downstream systems. The candidate must be adept at leveraging AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Airflow, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, SageMaker (including SageMaker Unified Studio), and Amazon QuickSight to architect comprehensive cloud\-native data solutions. Strong capabilities in data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical layers are required, with experience in dimensional and normalized schemas suited for both analytical and operational workloads.


Soft skills involve advanced problem\-solving and analytical abilities to identify and resolve complex data quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance challenges in distributed systems. Effective communication and stakeholder management are critical, enabling collaboration with technical teams, data product owners, business leaders, and governance stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery. Experience within the banking domain, specifically transaction banking in areas such as trade finance, payments, cash management, and supply chain finance, is preferred.


Hard skills:


Expertise in data architecture frameworks and production implementations.


Proficient in real\-time data streaming with Apache Kafka.


Skilled in AWS data service platforms for end\-to\-end cloud\-native solutions.


Strong data modeling across various schema designs and workloads.


Soft skills:


Analytical problem\-solving for complex distributed data systems.


Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.


Domain knowledge in commercial banking transaction services.

title: Agentforce Technical Architect( Salesforce exp is a must)
description:
**Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a
 **Strategist** 
 , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an
 **Orchestrator** 
 , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Strategist Mindset**
* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.


**Orchestrator Mindset**
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.


 Delivery \& Governance
   

  

 Builder Mindset
   

  

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs\-of\-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end\-to\-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost\-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise\-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM\-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.
* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.
* Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Exposure to multi\-org, multi\-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e.g., Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real\-world settings.
* Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool\-use patterns.
* Comfortable working directly in code/config to build and ship — not purely a design\-and\-document architect.

title: Solution Architect - AI, Cross Industries
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands\-on AI Solution Architect (SA). AWS Solutions Architect \- AI are SA's with deep domain\-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
   

  

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting Customers AI ambition into reality
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI SA builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud\-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead hands\-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader Solution Architecture organization.


 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect\-AI team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement GenAI/AgenticSolutions . In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Cross Industries work hand in hand with AWS customers across mutliple verticals like Auto/Manu, Retail/CPG, HCLS, Travel/Hospitality to help drive AWS GenAI/Agentic services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of GenAI/Agentic AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 5\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* 5\+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Hands\-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private\-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization.
* 6\+ years of design/implementation of production AI systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Proven ability to lead projects with complex challenges with extensible, operationally excellent, cost optimized, and aligned solutions outcomes
* Expertise in architecting AI systems within highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector).


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**About Chubb** 




  





 Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S\&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.
 



  





**About Chubb India** 




  





 At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow
 



  





 With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start\-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution\-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.
 



 We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real\-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.
 



  





**Position Details** 




  




* **Job Title: Solution Architect**
* **Function/Department: Technology**
* **Location: Hyderabad**
* **Employment Type: Full Time**
* **Reports To: Domain Architect / Chief Architect**



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Solution Architect is a senior technical leader within Chubb’s Global Architecture team. This individual translates complex business and insurance\-domain requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions—taking an end\-to\-end view of business processes and spanning multiple domains, including security, infrastructure, data, integration, and application layers across Chubb’s worldwide operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities and Focus Areas** 




  





**Strategic Impact** 




  




* Partner with C\-suite and business leaders on technology roadmaps.
* Support the development of a strategy or vision that aligns with organizational objectives.
* Lead the Investment Planning process (Technology Strat Plan) by:
* Gathering business drivers and demand,
* Balancing priorities,
* Defining regional technology strategy and roadmap.



  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Lead end\-to\-end solution design for enterprise initiatives.
* Guide engineering squads through architecture reviews and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Own non\-functional requirements, including performance, security, and scalability.
* Drive reusable architecture, design patterns, standards, and policy.
* Participate in and present at design forums to defend solution designs.
* Frame initiatives from the inception phase and provide support for Cost\-Benefit Analysis (CBA).



  





**Cross\-Domain Collaboration** 



* Mentor junior architects and senior engineers.
* Work closely with key business stakeholders—including underwriting, claims, operations, actuarial, finance, and distribution—to understand business objectives, products, and processes.
* Translate business requirements and pain points into viable solution options, clearly highlighting impacts, risks, and trade\-offs.
* Participate in governance forums (such as architecture boards, design reviews, and project steering groups) to present and defend solution designs.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* **Architecture Design \& Governance**
* Define and own solution blueprints for large\-scale enterprise programs. Conduct architecture reviews, enforce architectural standards, and ensure that all designs comply with Chubb’s security and regulatory requirements—including GDPR, SOX, and local insurance mandates.



  




* **Cloud \& Infrastructure Strategy**
* Drive Chubb’s cloud transformation agenda across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments. Define cloud landing zone patterns, establish FinOps guardrails, and set infrastructure\-as\-code standards using technologies such as Terraform and Kubernetes.



  




* **Integration \& API Design**
* Architect event\-driven and API\-first integration patterns using Kafka, MuleSoft, and REST/GraphQL APIs. Ensure seamless, secure, and scalable connectivity between core insurance systems—such as Policy, Claims, and Billing—and modern digital channels.



  




* **Data \& Analytics Architecture**
* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design modern data architectures, including data lakes, data mesh implementations, and real\-time streaming platforms. These architectures should enable advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) capabilities across the enterprise.



  




* **Security \& Resilience**
* Embed security by design throughout the architecture lifecycle. Implement zero\-trust networking principles, robust identity \& access management (IAM), strong encryption standards, and proven disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity architecture patterns.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement**
* Communicate complex architectural concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Produce well\-structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and present strategic architectural proposals and reviews to governance boards and executive leadership.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field
* Master’s degree preferred (MBA or MSc in Technology Management a plus)



  





**Experience** 



* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 4–5 years in a Solution or Enterprise Architect role
* Demonstrated experience delivering architecture for large, complex, multi\-geography programs
* Insurance or Financial Services domain experience strongly preferred



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence at VP / SVP / C\-level
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to lead, influence, and mentor across distributed, global teams
* Communicates effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Takes the lead in explaining complex concepts to support decision\-making
* Leads or guides team members; demonstrates awareness of risk factors in their work



  





**Technical Skills** 



* **Cloud platforms** 
 : AWS (preferred), Azure – design \& migration patterns
* **Containerization \& orchestration** 
 : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
* **Integration** 
 : MuleSoft, Kafka, REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI
* **Data** 
 : Snowflake, Databricks, event streaming, data mesh
* **DevSecOps** 
 : CI/CD pipelines, Terraform / IaC, SAST/DAST tooling



  





**Domain Skills** 



* **Lines of business** 
 : P\&C, Personal Lines, Specialty and A\&H
* **Domain coverage** 
 : Distribution, quote \& bind, policy, billing, claims, reinsurance, catastrophe management and finance
* **Solution types** 
 : insurance packaged platforms, custom build, digital portals, finance/shared services applications, integration, data \& analytics, workflow/automation



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  




* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment.



  





**Why Chubb?** 




  





 Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!
 



 Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start\-up\-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.
 



  




* **Industry leader:** 
 Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* **A Great Place to work:** 
 Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023\-2024, 2024\-2025 and 2025\-2026
* **Laser focus on excellence** 
 : At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* **Start\-Up Culture** 
 : Embracing the spirit of a start\-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* **Growth and success** 
 : As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment



  





**Application Process** 




  





 Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent, and inclusive.
 


* **Step 1** 
 : Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal / Linkedin
* **Step 2** 
 : Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* **Step 3** 
 : Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* **Step 4** 
 : Final interaction with Chubb leadership.



  





**Join Us** 




  





 With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a
 **global stage** 
 or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value
 **integrity, innovation, and inclusion** 
 , and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to
 **be part of Chubb India’s journey** 
 .

**Position Summary**
 As the Informatica Architect you will architect, design, lead and govern enterprise data management solutions using Informatica Master Data Management (MDM), Reference Data Management (RDM), Data Quality (IDQ), and Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC). You will define target\-state data architectures, establish reusable data management patterns, guide implementation teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and trust across the enterprise.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Define enterprise architecture and implementation roadmaps for Informatica MDM, RDM, IDQ, and CDGC.
* Design employer, employee, services, projects and other domain\-specific master data solutions.
* Develop MDM models, hierarchies, relationships, match\-and\-merge rules, survivorship strategies, and trust frameworks.
* Design reference data structures, mappings, crosswalks, validation rules, and stewardship processes.

* Familiarity with privacy, security, retention, and access\-control considerations for sensitive personal data and knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, etc.

title: Principal Software Architect-AI
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Unified Communication team at Motorola Solutions is seeking an accomplished and visionary Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead our Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and Strategic Project initiatives. This pivotal role involves leading a high\-performing engineering team focused on designing, developing, and deploying cutting\-edge AI\-driven solutions that enhance our unified communication products and services. The ideal candidate possesses a deep technical background in software engineering, a proven track record of managing and mentoring technical teams, and extensive experience in bringing AI/ML models from research, prototypes to production\-ready enterprise systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Leadership and Management
   

  

* Lead the software engineers, machine learning engineers, and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Define team priorities, allocate resources, manage project timelines, and ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery of AI/ML\-powered features.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support the career development of team members.
* Collaborate with product management and cross\-functional teams to translate business needs and product requirements into technical specifications and a clear AI/ML roadmap.


**Technical Strategy and Execution**
* Define the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for integrating AI and ML capabilities across the Unified Communication product portfolio (e.g., natural language processing for translation, transcription and summarization, predictive analytics, intelligent routing, conversational AI).
* Oversee the entire AI/ML lifecycle, from data collection and model training to MLOps, deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Ensure the engineering team adheres to best practices in software development, including code review, unit testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and secure coding standards.
* Drive the selection and implementation of appropriate technologies, frameworks, and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) to support scalable and robust AI infrastructure.

description:

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**About the Role**
------------------

The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a **Strategist** , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an **Orchestrator** , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Strategist Mindset**

* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.

### **Orchestrator Mindset**

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.

### **Delivery \& Governance**

### **Builder Mindset**

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs\-of\-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end\-to\-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost\-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 13\+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise\-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM\-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.
* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.
* Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Exposure to multi\-org, multi\-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e.g., Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real\-world settings.
* Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool\-use patterns.

title: Solution Architect - Trade Finance
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Solution Architect with deep Trade Finance domain expertise to define the target\-state architecture and high\-level design for the Trade Finance domain, aligned to business outcomes and the bank's strategic direction. This role spans business, application, data, and technology architecture — owning the end\-to\-end solution design and transformation roadmap, including integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, translating complex domain requirements into well\-structured architectural solutions and guiding them through stakeholder alignment, impact analysis, and implementation planning.


##### **Responsibilities**


Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, domain architects, and technical SMEs to gain a comprehensive understanding of the current Trade Finance architecture, including systems landscape, data flows, integration points, and technology stack.


Document the existing architecture thoroughly, identifying pain points, technical debt, capability gaps, operational inefficiencies, and risks that limit business agility or scalability.


Capture and articulate business objectives, strategic drivers, and domain\-specific requirements to inform the target architectural vision.


Define the target architectural strategy for Trade Finance aligned with the organization’s overall business and technology strategies and enterprise architecture guidelines.


Ensure the strategy addresses Trade Finance domain specifics—such as documentary credits, guarantees, collections, supply chain finance, and compliance—and integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms.


Align the strategy with modern architecture principles, including cloud\-native design, API\-first, event\-driven patterns, and data\-centric approaches, while managing legacy system migration challenges.


Define the target solution architecture covering business, application, data, and technology domains.


Design end\-to\-end architectural views and process flows for the full Trade Finance scope, including integration patterns with Payments, Core Banking, regulatory reporting, and external messaging systems.


Develop high\-level design artifacts that clearly communicate the solution to technical teams and business stakeholders.


Document and assess transformation roadmap options for Trade Finance, evaluating feasibility, risk, time\-to\-value, and organizational impact.


Define the recommended end\-to\-end roadmap, outlining capability sequencing, migration phases, and key milestones.


Produce a high\-level implementation roadmap detailing impacts on related domains, dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and secure approval from relevant stakeholders including business leadership, enterprise architecture, domain leads, and delivery teams.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The candidate brings over 15 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in Solution or Enterprise Architecture roles within banking or financial services. They demonstrate expertise in defining target\-state architecture and high\-level designs encompassing business, application, data, and technology domains.


Hard skills include:


Deep domain knowledge of Trade Finance processes such as documentary credits, guarantees, collections, supply chain finance, trade loans, and compliance requirements like sanctions screening, AML, and KYC.


Strong understanding of Trade Finance integration with Payments infrastructure and Core Banking systems.


Proficiency in cloud\-native architectures, microservices design patterns, REST and event\-driven API design, contract\-first approaches, and various database models including relational, NoSQL, and event sourcing.


Experience in monolith\-to\-microservices migration and addressing legacy system modernization challenges in banking.


Development of architectural artifacts such as solution architecture documentation, high\-level designs, integration views, data flow diagrams, roadmaps, and options analyses.


Soft skills include:


Effective collaboration with diverse stakeholders across functions, domains, and regions.


Strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation abilities to achieve alignment and secure architectural approvals.


Comfort working in ambiguous environments, translating incomplete business requirements into structured architectural options with well\-defined trade\-offs.


Nice to have

title: Senior AI Solution Architect
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands\-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain\-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
   

  

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud\-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

* Experience giving skills and communicating complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences across different functions
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
